Name: Ambarish Raghuvanshi
Designation: Co-Promoter and Former CFO, Info Edge India Ltd
Bio: Ambarish Raghuvanshi is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Ambarish has been an Independent Advisor since mid-2014. He formerly served as the CFO and Head of Legal and Administration at Naukri Internet Services Pvt Ltd until 2014 and also as the CFO and Group President of Finance at Info Edge (India) Pvt Ltd. Prior to joining Info Edge, Ambarish worked with companies such as Standard Chartered Bank, HSBC, and the Bank of America, where he assisted and advised corporates across a wide spectrum of industries on capital raising and mergers and acquisitions. He has advised two companies that completed very successful IPOs in the last five years. He spends time helping startups scale as an angel investor. As an avid reader, he likes to read two books simultaneously, only reading printed books, and mostly reads nonfiction.
Education: PGDBM, XLRI Jamshedpur | CA, ICAI | BCom Hons, St Xavier's College
Research_Summary: Co-Promoter and Former CFO, Info Edge India Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ameet Kumar Gupta
Designation: Whole Time Director, Havells India Ltd
Bio:
Ameet Kumar Gupta is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Ameet joined Havells in 1995 post his MBA in USA. He focused on making Havells technology savvy through collaborating with global companies initially and then developing an in-house Research and Development Centre.

He believes in integrating manufacturing ethos with sustainability with an aim to give back to the environment more than we source. Havells was the only Indian electrical company to be included in Dow Jones Sustainability Index since 2019. He is credited with Havells manufacturing more than 95% of its products in-house against industry norms of less than 50%.

He is on the Board of Visitors, Business School, Wake Forest University.

Ameet enjoys music, golf and travel.
Education: BTech, Electronics and Communication, Delhi University | MBA, Wake Forest University
Research_Summary: Whole Time Director, Havells India Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Anil Rai Gupta
Designation: Chairman and Managing Director, Havells India Ltd
Bio:
Anil Rai Gupta is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Anil, under the mentorship of his father Late Shri Qimat Rai Gupta, led Havells' transformation into the largest consumer electrical company. He was instrumental in deepening Havells' reach into homes and leveraging technology, innovation and distribution network to deliver industry leading growth.

Anil is on the Board of Trustees of Wake Forest University, his alma mater. He is also Founder and Trustee of Ashoka University.

He has keen interest in cultural and historical conservation and believes in education as a key change agent for an individual and his family.

He loves singing, golf and travel.
Education: BCom, SRCC, New Delhi | MBA, Wake Forest University
Research_Summary: Chairman and Managing Director, Havells India Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ashish Kacholia
Designation: Director, Lucky Investment Managers Pvt Ltd
Bio:
Ashish Kacholia is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Ashish is the founder of Lucky Investments Managers. He is also a proprietary investor in the Indian equity markets. He started his career at Prime Securities and also had a brief stint at Edelweiss Capital before establishing Lucky.

He holds a BE in Production Engineering from Mumbai University and an MMS from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies. Ashish is a keen golfer, music lover, and fitness enthusiast. His principal philanthropic interests include education, health care, livelihoods, wildlife, and sports.
Education: BE, Production Engineering, Mumbai University | MMS, Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies
Research_Summary: Director, Lucky Investment Managers Pvt Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Binny Bansal
Bio: Binny Bansal is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Binny co-founded Flipkart, India's leading e-commerce marketplace in 2007. As CEO, he played a pivotal role in scaling the company, culminating in Walmart's USD 20 billion acquisition of Flipkart in 2018, then the largest global Merger and Acquisition deal in e-commerce. Post-Flipkart, he has focused on investing in and mentoring startups. He also co-founded xto10x Technologies, a company that helps businesses scale globally. He actively advises and serves on the boards of multiple startups and organizations. A philanthropist at heart, Binny's foundation is supporting various initiatives in the areas of entrepreneurship, education and improving livelihoods.
Education: BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founder, xto10x; Co-founder, Flipkart; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Gagan Hasteer
Bio: Gagan Hasteer is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Gagan is a technologist and entrepreneur with passion for innovation. He thrives in leading innovation and execution in a fast paced environment. In his 20 years of experience as a technology leader, he has built exceptional teams, delivered cutting-edge products and worked with customers to drive business objectives.
Education: EMBA, Wharton School | MS and PhD, Computer Science, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: VP, Infrastructure Engineering, Netflix; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Harish Shah
Designation: Chairperson, Harish and Bina Shah Foundation
Bio: Harish Shah is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Harish is a first generation entrepreneur and philanthropist. He founded Signet Excipients, India's leading supplier of pharmaceutical raw materials. After 38 years of successfully running the company, Signet was sold to IMCD NV. In his current role, Harish is the Founder and Managing Director of Signet Capital, his family office focusing on strategic investments across diverse asset classes and sectors and is also the Chairperson of the Harish and Bina Shah Foundation. In addition to championing causes that reflect his deepest values, Harish is actively involved in the foundation's governance and strategic functions and serves on the board of several prominent institutions in the field of education, healthcare and cultural heritage. His diverse pursuits illustrate a profound commitment to both business excellence and social impact.
Education: BE, Mechanical Engineering, DMS Bombay University
Research_Summary: Chairperson, Harish and Bina Shah Foundation; Founder and Managing Director, Signet Capital Pvt Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Hitesh Oberoi
Designation: Co-Promoter, MD and CEO, Info Edge India Ltd
Bio:
Hitesh Oberoi is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Hitesh is a Co-Promoter, MD and CEO of Info Edge India Limited. Apart from the country's leading job site, Naukri.com, Info Edge also owns 99acres.com, Jeevansathi.com, and Shiksha.com and has investments in various internet startups like Zomato and PolicyBazaar as well. With over 20 years of experience in the internet industry, he is part of various industry forums. He is a charter member of the TiE, New Delhi and also the past Chairman of The Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI).

He is also one of the Founders and a Trustee of Ashoka University. An alumnus of IIT Delhi and IIM Bangalore, he won the prestigious Ernst and Young Entrepreneur of the Year award for Business Transformation in 2008 along with his partner. He has also been awarded the Distinguished Alumnus Award of 2019 by IIM Bangalore.
Education: MBA, IIM Bengaluru | BTech Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-Promoter, MD and CEO, Info Edge India Ltd; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Jai Rajpal
Designation: Founder and CEO, Crescent Asset Management Asia
Bio:
Jai Rajpal is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Jai is the founder and CEO of Crescent Asset Management Asia Pvt Ltd, an investment manager based out of Singapore that runs a Global Macro Hedge Fund.

Jai spent over 20 years in the fixed income trading business at Deutsche Bank, Lehman Brothers and Nomura, prior to setting up Crescent in January 2015.
Education: MBA, IIM Calcutta | Bachelor's, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founder and CEO, Crescent Asset Management Asia; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: John Firth
Designation: Advisor, Harish and Bina Shah Foundation
Bio: John Firth is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. John is the Director of Global Health and Development at Rethink Priorities, a think-and-do tank which works on significant opportunities for impact across different areas globally, including animal welfare, health and development, climate catastrophic risks, artificial intelligence, and more. Before joining Rethink Priorities, John held academic positions at Oxford University, UK, the University of Notre Dame, USA, and was a postdoctoral fellow at the Centre for Global Development. He worked with J-PAL South Asia for two years running randomized control trials (RCTs) in India. John holds a PhD in Economics from MIT, and a BA in Philosophy from Notre Dame. At the Harish and Bina Shah Foundation (HBSF), he plays a key advisory role on partnerships focused on economic development and reform.
Education: PhD, Development Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
Research_Summary: Advisor, Harish and Bina Shah Foundation; Director, Global Health and Development, Rethink Priorities; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Madhusudan Kela
Bio:
Madhusudan Kela is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Madhusudan is one of the most well-known and seasoned investors in Indian capital markets, with an extensive experience of over 27 years in both sell side and buy side investment mandates. He has skillfully played the role of Chief Investment Officer for over a decade, leading a team of over 40 investment professionals, and managing the Equity AUM portfolio of the largest asset management company (by total AUM) in India. Madhu has been profiled by leading Indian and international magazines, including the likes of Forbes and Asiamoney. His views are sought after by the leading business news channels in India including CNBC TV18, ET Now, Bloomberg, BTVI (all English), and CNBC Awaaz, Zee Business (Hindi).

He is a regular panelist for sharing investment views, and opinion on a host of macro and thematic events. He has also hosted or been a panel invitee to major conferences including those organized by industry bodies like FICCI, CII, leading domestic and international institutions related to capital markets etc.
Education: Masters, Finance & Financial Management Services, Mumbai University
Research_Summary: Founder, MK Ventures; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Mukul Agrawal
Bio: Mukul Agrawal is a successful and leading capital market investor in India, with more than two decades of experience in the listed as well as unlisted space. An avid reader, he has in-depth knowledge of the economy and politics and also advises leading corporates from time to time. He is associated with various reputed social institutions in the fields of healthcare and education.
Research_Summary: Founder Chairman, Param Capital

Name: Natasha Malpani
Bio: Natasha Malpani is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Natasha is the Founder of Boundless Ventures. After studying Immunology at the University of Oxford, Natasha was a founding team member at Big Society Capital, a USD 1 billion fund in London. She completed her MBA at Stanford University, where she focused on design thinking and innovation. Since then, Natasha has worked for Pocket Aces and founded Boundless Media, an award-winning content studio. In her current role, she combines her investing and creative background by partnering with great founders at an early stage.
Education: MBA, Stanford University | MPhil, University of Cambridge | MSc, University of Oxford
Research_Summary: Founder, Boundless Ventures; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rakesh Bharti Mittal
Bio:
Rakesh Bharti Mittal is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Rakesh is Vice Chairman of Bharti Enterprises, one of India's leading business groups with interests in telecom, agri-food business, financial services, realty, and communication and media devices. Rakesh is the Chairman of Bharti AXA Life Insurance, Bharti AXA General Insurance and FieldFresh Foods. He is also a Non-Executive Director of Bharti Airtel and Managing Director of Bharti Realty Limited. Rakesh served as the President of CII for 2018-19. He has been the Chair of several CII Councils and Committees at the national level. Rakesh has been awarded the Honorary Doctor of Civil Law Degree by Newcastle University, UK.

He is a recipient of several awards including the prestigious Horasis Indian Business Leader of the Year 2016 Award (Internationalization), Institute of Engineers - Engineering Excellence Award 2004, and LMA - Entrepreneur of the Year Award 1992. In 2019, the Satish Chander Dhawan (SCD) College, Ludhiana bestowed Rakesh with the Lifetime Achievement Award for his invaluable contributions in business, different areas of public interest, and to the nation as a whole.
Education: PG Diploma, Electronics and Controls, YMCA Institute of Engineering
Research_Summary: Vice Chairman, Bharti Enterprises; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Suchitra Lohia
Bio:
Suchitra Lohia is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. As one of the founders of IVL, Suchitra has played a hands-on role in the growth of the world's leading intermediate petrochemicals manufacturer since its inception in 1990. Suchitra chairs the global Corporate Social Responsibility Committee and is the Chairwoman of the IVL Foundation, a nonprofit organization focused on creating positive impact for children, women and the environment.

At present, she is spearheading several strategic transformative initiatives that are designed for businesses to achieve their full potential. She is also driving the ONE IVL branding exercise to culturally integrate the diverse IVL family and has recently taken up the role of lead sponsor for Global Communications.
Education: OPM, Harvard Business School | BCom, Delhi University
Research_Summary: Executive Director, Indorama Ventures; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sunny Singh
Bio:
Sunny (Gurpreet) Singh is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Sunny has a vision for the world, that all of humanity embrace Wholistic Wellbeing while helping their communities grow and taking care of the planet. His vision extends to corporates as well: That each corporate take charge of a single (or more) societal problem and work on it until all the problems in the world have been solved, because this is why corporates exist and this is what they do best.

Sunny walks the talk, he has taken ownership of many societal and environmental problems and is investing in impact initiatives in the field of sports (RoundGlass Sports) and sustainability (RoundGlass Sustain) focused on action for the good of the individual, community, and the entire planet. To this effect, he has set up a world class football, hockey, and tennis academy and acquired RoundGlass Punjab Football Club to inspire Indian kids and youth to play.

He founded RoundGlass in 2014 to enable and empower communities and individuals on the path of Wholistic Wellbeing through technology-enabled solutions and apps, expert-led content, and by providing access to the world's best teachers and experts. Sunny also wants to transform the prevailing reaction based approach in healthcare to one that is proactive and focused on prevention, in addition to treatment.

He has designed RoundGlass in such a manner that it is self-sustaining. RoundGlass's commercial services, its corporate wellbeing solution, apps and collectives, and practice management platform RoundGlass Cross, fuel its social impact initiatives. These are RoundGlass Sports, which is grooming the next generation of sporting talent in India and giving every child in Punjab a chance to play, and RoundGlass Sustain, which is taking to the world a media-rich digital encyclopedia of Indian biodiversity. Then there is the RoundGlass Foundation, which aims to restore wellbeing to 12,500 villages in Punjab, India.

Sunny's story is one of perseverance and hard work, and the success that comes when you follow your passion and put your heart and soul in it. Sunny grew up in a lower middle-class family in Punjab, India. His father was a sportsman, one of the best Indian hockey players at some point, something he achieved through sheer effort and that has always served as an inspiration for Sunny. Sunny now lives in Seattle in the US with his family.

After working with companies such as Expeditors International and Microsoft, Sunny became an entrepreneur in 1996 with Edifecs, now a market leader in the global healthcare technology space that is improving the ways healthcare organizations manage and leverage the information they exchange. With RoundGlass, Sunny turned entrepreneur for the second time. He also earned epithets such as philanthropist, visionary, and Wholistic Wellbeing champion.

Sunny believes that everyone should have access to Wholistic Wellbeing or wellbeing across dimensions, physical, mental, financial, social, community, and planetary, and more. The path to Wholistic Wellbeing includes everything from meditation, yoga, physical exercise, social interactions, food, working for the community, the planet, etc.

Sunny feels the universe has been kind to him and has put him in a special position to be able to do what he loves. So, with RoundGlass, he decided to give back what he has received from the universe. The journey of life, according to Sunny, is the journey of wellbeing. RoundGlass is an instrument of change that seeks to empower everyone on this life journey of Wholistic Wellbeing.
Education: Dual MS, Montana State University | BTech, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Partner, RoundGlass; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Varna Puvvada
Bio:
Varna Puvvada is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. She is also the Senior Director of Engineering at Meta, where she leads the fast-growing Ads Serving Infrastructure organization across multiple sites, including the Bay Area, New York and Toronto. Her work focuses on building and scaling Meta's mission-critical ad infrastructure, which drives the company's revenue. She works closely with machine learning teams to advance AI infrastructure, leveraging cutting-edge hardware and software innovations.

With more than two decades of experience in large-scale distributed systems and ML platforms, Varna has played a key role in developing reliable, efficient and privacy-aware infrastructure. Prior to Meta, she was a Principal Member of Technical Staff at PayPal, where she led the development of the Core Server Framework and spearheaded major system migrations. She also held engineering leadership roles at Symantec, Invio Software, Healtheon WebMD, and Tandem/Compaq, contributing to automation, provisioning tools and large-scale infrastructure solutions.

Varna is passionate about building and growing high-performing engineering teams, mentoring talent, and fostering collaboration across organizations.
Education: MS, Computer Science, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | BE, Computer Science, Osmania University
Research_Summary: Senior Director of Engineering, Meta; Founder and Distinguished Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Aakash Chaudhry
Bio:
Aakash Chaudhry is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is also the Co-founder and Chief Mentor of Aakash Educational Services Limited (AESL). He leads the senior management team and is responsible for the overall supervision and direction of the company.

Prior to AESL, he worked with top IT companies such as Infosys Technologies and Cognizant Technology Solutions, where he gained extensive experience in business management. At AESL, he follows his passion of helping deserving students and has been dedicatedly working towards providing focused and quality education across the nation through effective delivery channels.

Aakash has transformed AESL into an established brand known for providing cutting-edge and niche educational services. He has been instrumental in putting in place new age systems that make operations more efficient, support and encourage skilled talent, leverage technological advancements and overall automation and follow agile marketing practices. This has ensured that Aakash classrooms, hybrid and digital continue to evolve such that they are the best offering in the industry.

He is the driving force behind the expansion of the company's educational services portfolio to IIT JEE test preparatory services, foundation coaching services as well as digital learning programs.

The Aakash group has investment from Think and Learn Pvt Ltd (BYJU'S) as well as by the world's largest private equity firm Blackstone.

In 2018, Aakash was featured in Business World's '40 Under 40', a list of the most disruptive young leaders in India Inc. He has also been adjudged the Most Promising Business Leaders of Asia 2020-21 by Economic Times.

An alumnus of Harvard Business School, Aakash is an engineer by profession. He holds a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, and an MBA from the Indian School of Business (ISB), Hyderabad.
Education: OPM, Management, Harvard Business School | MBA, ISB, Hyderabad
Research_Summary: Founder and MD, Sparkl Edventure; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ajay Arora
Bio:
Ajay Arora is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University.

Ajay, Managing Director of D'Decor, has been in the family business since 1991. Back then the company was known as Dicitex Industries. Ajay has been instrumental in growing the company into an international brand, D'Decor with his vision and business acumen. The company has achieved a leadership position in the international and domestic markets and is currently the world's largest manufacturer of curtains and upholstery fabrics.

Ajay believes that one of the key drivers of success in today's market is digital. Poised for growth in a digital economy, D'Decor has aligned its corporate strategy and digital initiatives to deliver winning customer propositions. As a pioneering move in the industry, D'Decor has successfully launched various digital assets that cater to both, the trade as well as the end consumer. From computer-aided design and manufacturing to enhancing the in-store experience, digital is at the heart of D'Decor.

Alumnus of the prestigious Owner President Management program at Harvard Business School, Ajay has also studied Textile Engineering from VJTI, Mumbai.
Education: OPM, Business, Harvard Business School | Textile Engineering, VJTI
Research_Summary: Managing Director, D'Decor Home Fabrics; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ajay Bhardwaj
Designation: CEO, Founder and Managing Director, Anthem Biosciences
Bio:
Ajay Bhardwaj is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University.

Ajay is the CEO, Founder and Managing Director of Anthem Biosciences. He started his career with Max India and then worked for Biocon, starting off as one of the earliest team members at Biocon, who helped build the company to a USD 600 Mn+ market cap organization (in 2006). As the President, Marketing, at Biocon he was instrumental in Biocon's rapid growth and spearheaded the company's foray into new areas like life sciences, contract research and clinical research.

Along with co-founders, Ganesh Sambasivam and KC Ravindra, he started Anthem Biosciences in 2006. Over the course of the last decade and half, they have scaled up Anthem Biosciences into one of India's fastest growing biotech CDMO companies, and a preferred partner of choice for Big Pharma and emerging biotech innovators globally.

He completed his BTech in Chemical Engineering from IIT Delhi in 1982 and received his Master's from Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, LA after receiving a Fellowship.
Education: Masters, Louisiana State University, LA | BTech, Chemical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: CEO, Founder and Managing Director, Anthem Biosciences; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Alok Mittal
Designation: Co-founder and Executive Chairman, Indifi Technologies
Bio:
Alok Mittal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is the Co-founder and Executive Chairman of Indifi, a platform to expand access to debt financing for Indian SMEs. A successful first generation entrepreneur based in India, Alok is also a founding member of Indian Angel Network, which is a forum for making angel investments. He last led India operations of Canaan Partners, a premier US based venture capital firm. Earlier, he co-founded JobsAhead.com in 1999. JobsAhead.com is the leading e-recruitment business focused on the Indian market, and was acquired by Monster.com recently.

Before founding JobsAhead, Alok worked with Hughes Software in telecom and internet technologies. Alok is a Computer Science graduate from IIT Delhi, and completed his MS and Management of Technology programs from UC Berkeley. Alok is passionate about creating value through startups. He is also keenly interested in entrepreneurship development in India.
Education: MS, Management of Technology, University of California, Berkeley | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-founder and Executive Chairman, Indifi Technologies; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Anil Chawla
Bio:
"You will learn more from failures than success. Stay Hungry. Stay Foolish. Keep Going"

Anil Chawla served as an Assistant Vice President of GE Capital since Apr 1996 and within 3 years, was promoted to Chief Executive Officer, Commercial Finance, India in 1999. Chawla served as Chief Executive Officer, Commercial Finance, India and South East Asia since Mar 2003 and established a major presence in the commercial finance markets in India and South East Asia. He served as a Director of GE Capital Transportation Financial Services.

He serves as Member of the ALCO Committee. Anil started his entrepreneurial journey when he acquired GE Capital, now known as Clix Capital along with Pramod Bhasin and Aion Capital. Prior to this, Anil was heading DE Shaw India and was also the MD of GE India.

He was recently featured as a Thought Leader for Robb Report Singapore. He is an active YPO member, avid marathon runner and cyclist.
Research_Summary: Director, Clix Capital

Name: Anjali Rattan Nashier
Bio:
Anjali Rattan Nashier is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Anjali is a seasoned and visionary leader in the entrepreneurial landscape. She holds the position of Chairperson at Rattan India Enterprises Limited. Under her guidance, the company has achieved a remarkable market capitalization of approximately Rs 8,000 crore. Her entrepreneurial journey commenced with the establishment of Rattan India Solar, a venture in the renewable energy sector. With a diligent five year effort, she magnified the solar enterprise, eventually orchestrating its acquisition by GIP in a deal valued at around Rs 1,800 crore.

Presently, the Rattan India group thrives in various dynamic sectors, encompassing enterprises such as thermal power, where Rattan India stands as a prominent private power generator with an impressive combined installed capacity of 2,700 MW from thermal power plants located in Amravati and Nashik. In the burgeoning market of electric vehicles, Revolt has emerged as the foremost electric motorbike brand in India. The e-commerce sector sees the significant presence of Cocoblu Retail Limited, a major seller on Amazon India, with an annual sales turnover reaching approximately Rs 5,000 crore. Neosky has cemented its position as one of the leading drone companies in India, showcasing remarkable prowess in the field of aerial technology. Operating within the fintech domain, WeFin has established itself as a digital platform facilitating loan sourcing for over 30 banks.

Anjali, an individual of multifaceted expertise with a background in Electrical Engineering and Law, has further enriched her professional repertoire through the completion of the prestigious OPM program at Harvard Business School. Additionally, she proudly stands as an esteemed alumna of the Judge Business School at the University of Cambridge. Her diverse educational background and astute business acumen have played pivotal roles in steering the Rattan India conglomerate toward its phenomenal success across various industries.
Education: OPM, Harvard Business School | Judge Business School, University of Cambridge
Research_Summary: Chairperson, Rattan India Enterprises Limited; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Anurag Goel
Designation: Co-founder and General Partner, Cactus Partners
Bio: Anurag Goel is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Anurag is the Co-founder and General Partner at Cactus Venture Partners, an early growth stage venture firm investing in consumer and technology startups. He is also the Co-founder and Chairman of Cactus Communications, a global science technology enterprise with operations across 10 countries. Anurag has 23+ years of deep expertise across strategy, MandA, technology and AI, and corporate development. As part of corporate development, his key interest areas are strategy, people management, D2C brand building, organization design, and leadership development. Anurag started his career in Amsterdam with McKinsey and Co. Anurag graduated from the Management and Technology Program with degrees in Computer Science and Finance from The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania.
Education: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
Research_Summary: Co-founder and General Partner, Cactus Partners; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Apurva Parekh
Designation: Executive Vice Chairman, Pidilite Industries Limited
Bio: Apurva Parekh is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Apurva is the Executive Vice Chairman at Pidilite Industries Limited. He has done his Bachelor's in Chemical Engineering from the University of Wisconsin at Madison and has been working in Pidilite Industries Limited since 1995. Apurva is closely involved in MandA, Strategy and Governance at Pidilite.
Education: Chemical Engineering, University of Wisconsin, Madison
Research_Summary: Executive Vice Chairman, Pidilite Industries Limited; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Arjun Bhagat
Bio:
Arjun Bhagat is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Arjun is the Chairman of Calibrated Group, an investment partnership that builds and invests in off-shoring businesses out of India. He also serves as a partner in Marymount Investors, LLC, a USD 300 million real estate investment firm he co-founded. Arjun was the President and Chief Executive Officer of RM Software India Pvt Ltd (RMSI). Arjun was responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of RMSI, and was personally responsible for building strategic customer relationships and opening offices in the UK, Belgium, Japan, Canada and Australia.

As the CFO of Risk Management Inc, a venture funded (Bain Capital and Sutter Hill) company, he led the spin-off of RMSI, a software and BPO company focused on the Geographical Information Systems space. Starting with 5 employees, he grew the company to an 800 person operation with an additional network capacity of 500 seats. In 1999, he negotiated the sale of the company to DMGI, the technology investment arm of the Daily Mail Group based out of the UK. Arjun currently sits on the board of, and is a major investor in five privately held companies.
Education: MBA, Finance, UCLA Anderson School of Management | BTech, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Chairman and CEO, Calibrated Group; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ashish Gupta
Designation: Founder and CEO, Benori Knowledge Solutions
Bio:
Ashish Gupta is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Ashish is the Founder of Benori Ventures. Benori aspires to fundamentally reduce the cost of knowledge on our planet. He has coined the term Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO) and founded the global KPO industry. He started his career with McKinsey where he served as an Engagement Manager and spent about five years with them. He received his MBA from Carnegie Mellon University and BTech in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi.

He recently graduated from the Senior Executive Leadership Program at Harvard Business School. He is one of the Founders and Trustees of Ashoka University and also serves on the board of TiE Delhi.
Education: MBA, Carnegie Mellon University | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founder and CEO, Benori Knowledge Solutions; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Atul B Lall
Designation: Vice Chairman and MD, Dixon Technologies India Pvt Ltd
Bio: Info not available
Research_Summary: Vice Chairman and MD, Dixon Technologies India Pvt Ltd; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Basant Agarwal
Bio: Basant Agarwal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. With over 30 years of experience in business leadership and management, Basant began his career as a jewelry retailer before diversifying into the financial markets. He is both an active trader and long term investor in equities and commodities. He also owns and leads Aekum Realty, a real estate development brand.
Education: BSc Hons, Chemistry, St Stephen's College, Delhi
Research_Summary: Director, Aekum Realty; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Brijesh Agrawal
Designation: Co-founder and Director, IndiaMART InterMESH Limited
Bio:
Brijesh Agrawal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. A vital part of the core management team, Brijesh has been the driving force behind the creation of a plethora of innovative products at IndiaMART. Possessing a dynamic, intriguing, and exciting leadership style, he is known for steadily introducing eclectic strategies aimed at the growth of different verticals of the organization. Currently, Brijesh is spearheading Tolexo.com, a 100% subsidiary of IndiaMART, providing a seamless shopping experience for the largest collection of products needed by businesses, factories, offices, and laboratories.

Being a relationship-oriented leader, Brijesh plays a key role in aligning people and has inspired many professionals to excel in their respective fields. A management graduate from The University of Lucknow and an MBA from The National Institute of Integrated Learning and Management (NIILM), he is a sports lover, especially cricket.
Education: PGDBM, NIILM | BMS, University of Lucknow
Research_Summary: Co-founder and Director, IndiaMART InterMESH Limited; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: CP Gurnani
Bio:
CP Gurnani is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. As an accomplished business leader with extensive experience in international business development, startups, turnarounds, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions, CP led Tech Mahindra's transformation journey, including one of the biggest turnarounds in Indian corporate history - the acquisition and merger of Satyam. His inimitable style of leadership, combined with his sharp focus on customer experience, has helped Tech Mahindra emerge as one of India's leading digital IT solution providers. In a career spanning more than 35 years, CP has held several leading positions with HP, Perot Systems (India) Ltd, and HCL Corporation Ltd.

As an outstanding people manager, CP has an entrepreneurial style of management that is a blend of enthusiasm and dynamism. He tends to focus on people's strengths to bring out the best in them. Work hard and play hard is his motto, and he applies it to all aspects of his life with complete passion.
Education: Chemical Engineering, NIT Rourkela
Research_Summary: Co-founder, AlonOS; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Dalip Pathak
Designation: Special Limited Partner, Warburg Pincus LLC
Bio:
Dalip Pathak is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Dalip is a Special Limited Partner at Warburg Pincus. He joined Warburg Pincus in 1994 and has previously been both head of India and head of Europe for the firm. He remains engaged in India and currently focuses on broader firm-wide initiatives, including sourcing cross-border opportunities. Prior to joining Warburg Pincus, he was with the International Finance Corporation (The World Bank Group).

He is a member of the development board of The Francis Crick Institute, one of Europe's leading biomedical research centers, and is a member of both the Advisory Council of the South Asian Institute at Harvard University and EMPEA. Dalip also serves on the Board of Trustees of Asia House. He received a BA and an MA in economics from Delhi University and an MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.
Education: MBA, Wharton School | BA, MA, Economics, University of Delhi
Research_Summary: Special Limited Partner, Warburg Pincus LLC; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Divyata Ashiya
Bio:
Divyata Ashiya is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Divyata is Chief Operating Officer for the Merchant Banking Division International at Goldman Sachs based in London. The Merchant Banking Division is responsible for private market/alternatives investments across private equity, infrastructure, credit, and real estate. She rejoined Goldman Sachs in 2019 after working with a London-based fintech startup focused on financial inclusion and holistic financial portfolio delivery to customers of financial institutions and corporate pension funds. Prior to this, Divyata was based in Singapore as head of the client franchise for Goldman Sachs Asset Management across the region. She was Chair of the GS Female Managing Director Network Asia Pacific. She was also an active member of the United Nations Development Programme across Southeast Asia.

She has spent her international career in New York, Hong Kong, London, and Singapore in leadership roles across transactional and fiduciary businesses. Divyata has a BA from The Amherst College and an MBA from The INSEAD. Divyata remains passionate about education and women's leadership development, including in her home state of Rajasthan. She is a Fellow of the Second Wave Class of Aspen India's Leadership Initiative.
Education: MBA, INSEAD | BA, Amherst College
Research_Summary: Managing Director, Fortescue Capital; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Diwakar Nigam
Bio: Diwakar Nigam is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Diwakar co-founded Newgen in 1992. He is also a founding member of NASSCOM, India's apex information technology industry association. He was one of the members of NASSCOM's Anti Piracy Task Group. Prior to joining Newgen, he founded Softek and was associated with it for 12 years. Diwakar has been on the Board since Apr 1, 1993, and has more than 35 years of experience in the information technology industry. He is an alumnus of the University of Allahabad, IIT Delhi, and IIT Madras.
Research_Summary: CMD, Newgen Software Technologies

Name: Ganesh Ramani
Bio: Info not available
Research_Summary: Partner, Goldman Sachs; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Gaurav Suri
Bio:
"Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration" - Thomas Edison

Gaurav Suri is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Gaurav is the CEO of Arcesium. Gaurav was formerly a Managing Director and Head of Information Technology and Software Development for the DE Shaw group. From 1996 until Arcesium's launch in 2015, he focused on developing proprietary software associated with the DE Shaw group's investment management activities and building out the firm's software development operations in Hyderabad, India. He also oversaw the DE Shaw group's office in Hyderabad. Gaurav started his career in research at AT&T Bell Laboratories, where his research interests included large-scale, reliable distributed systems.
Education: MS, Computer Science, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: CEO, Arcesium LLC; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Gayatri Sondhi
Bio:
Gayatri Sondhi is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Gayatri is a private investor through Multipoint Capital LLC, a US-based family office. Until 2007 she was a Managing Director of Mavian Labs LLC, a venture capital partnership. Prior to co-founding Mavian Labs in 2000, Gayatri was a Vice President and Director in the New York office of Boston Consulting Group, a management consulting firm.

Gayatri has almost 30 years of experience working with organizations - big and small, high-tech and low-tech, as an advisor and an investor to develop strategy and operate effectively. She has an abiding interest in emerging deep-tech solutions and has supported successful startups in biotech and artificial intelligence. Gayatri is a graduate of Delhi University and holds an MBA from Harvard Business School.
Education: MBA, Harvard Business School | Entry 20175, University of Delhi
Research_Summary: Private Investor, Multipoint Capital LLC; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Harish Bahl
Bio: Harish Bahl is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is a serial entrepreneur who has successfully founded and built some of the leading e-commerce and digital media companies across Asia and other emerging markets. He is the Founder and Chairman of Smile Group, the India-based Asian Internet Group, with extensive holdings in the consumer internet and digital media space. As a business builder, Smile partners with the best entrepreneurs, venture capitalists, and global companies to build digital companies from scratch, expand operations, and increase their footprint by rolling out internationally. In the past, it has partnered and built businesses with leading companies like Airbnb, WPP Digital, Ogilvy, Yahoo!, ScanGroup (Africa), and worked with top Silicon Valley and European investors.
Education: BTech, Computer Science, SDM College of Engineering and Technology
Research_Summary: Founder and Chairman, Smile Group; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Kapil Agarwal
Bio:
Kapil Agarwal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He has over 23 years of experience providing business and technology solutions with a focus on process development, reengineering, and best practices. Since 2005, he has utilized his enterprise and SMB application skills to implement NetSuite for a wide array of companies in the software, manufacturing, distribution, education, healthcare, and financial services industries. Before founding Upaya, he spent one year at NetSuite in Professional Services and five years at Oracle in various capacities as a Financial and Accounting Expert for Oracle Applications. Kapil continues to lead a course specializing in data relationships and database design at DeAnza College (California).

He is an ex-Manorite (St George's College, Mussoorie, India) and holds an MS in Mathematics and Computer Science from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, India. Kapil enjoys biking and listening to music to relax.
Education: MS, Computer and Mathematics
Research_Summary: Advisor, Immersa.ai; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Kavita Iyer
Designation: Managing Trustee, Singhal Iyer Family Foundation
Bio: Kavita is the Managing Trustee of SIFF and drives the strategy and path for SIFF's programs in Education and the Arts. She is also the Co-founder of Young Artiste, an online platform that aims to universalize music and arts education. Prior to this, she was the Co-founder and CEO of Minglebox, a startup in online education, and was part of the Tata Administrative Service, where she was an early member of the founding team of Tanishq. Kavita is an alumna of IIT Delhi (Director's Gold Medal) and IIM Ahmedabad and an avid Hindustani vocalist.
Research_Summary: Managing Trustee, Singhal Iyer Family Foundation

Name: Lalit Agarwal
Bio:
Lalit Agarwal is an Indian retail entrepreneur, the Founder and CMD of V-Mart Retail, which he founded in 2002. With V-Mart he pioneered the concept of value fashion retailing in Tier II, III and IV towns in India. Under his stewardship, V-Mart's footprint has grown to 275 plus stores across 19 states, delivering affordable fashion to more than 35 million customers annually.

As a leading industry voice, Lalit holds the position of the Chairman of Retailers Association of India (RAI) as well as Chairman of Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) - Retail and FMCG for the Northern Region. He was awarded 'Retail Leader of the Year' in 2018 by the Indian Retail (Franchise India) as an acknowledgement of his visionary zeal and entrepreneurial success. He was a speaker at the World Retail Congress (WRC) in 2019, the foremost annual gathering of the retail industry globally. In 2017, he was nominated to the Niti Aayog's Champions of Change - an initiative by the Government of India.

Lalit attended the renowned Owner/President Management Program at Harvard Business School. He earned his bachelor's degree in Commerce from Bombay University, and a Diploma in Financial Management from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS), Mumbai.

Lalit writes a weekly blog on the dynamics and interplay of Leadership, Culture and Technology.

He loves to travel and shares his experiences at lalitagarwalspeaks.com.
Education: Financial Management, NMIMS
Research_Summary: Managing Director, V-Mart; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Manas Human
Bio: Manas Human is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Manas is the Chairperson of the Executive Board of Nagarro, a leading software services firm listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. He has a background in technology and operations management with PhD and BTech degrees from IIT Delhi, and an MSE degree from Stanford University. At Stanford he was a recipient of the SIMA Fellowship. He has worked as a researcher with the Harvard Business School's Technology and Operations Management group, and has advised Fortune 500 companies on operations strategy. His previous entrepreneurial ventures have included Dextrous Faber in manufacturing, SupplyChainge in stochastic retail supply chain optimization, MNI Partners in consulting, and the Proton Business School.
Education: PhD, Supply Chain Management, IIT Delhi | Research Associate, Technology and Operations, Harvard Business School | MS, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, Stanford University | BTech, Manufacturing Science and Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-founder and CEO, Nagarro; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Manu Gulati
Bio: Manu Gulati is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Manu Gulati is a Co-founder and Head, Engineering at NUVIA Inc which was a very fast unicorn, bought by Qualcomm recently. Manu's past experiences include Google, Apple and Broadcom, among others. He holds a BTech in Electrical Engineering from IIT Delhi and MS from UC Irvine.
Education: Master of Science, UC Irvine | BTech, Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: VP of Engineering, Qualcomm; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Mohit Thukral
Designation: Chief Executive Officer, Arise Virtual Solutions Inc
Bio:
Mohit Thukral is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is the Chief Executive Officer at Arise Virtual Solutions Inc. In his previous roles, he has been the Founder and Managing Partner of Vivtera, as well as Executive Officer and Business Leader at Genpact, where he led the organization's largest vertical (Banking, Financial Services and Insurance) globally and was responsible for shaping business strategy and aligning it with the future industry landscape, identifying key acquisitions and partnerships, as well as managing growth, profitability, and strategic client relationships.

Mohit played a pivotal role in the transformation of GE Capital International Services (GECIS) to Genpact in 2005 and helped achieve significant scale for the company's global businesses across North America, Europe, and Australia. An acknowledged industry thought leader, Mohit served as an elected member of the NASSCOM Executive Council, where he spearheaded the task force on FutureSkills - an initiative to re- and up-skill the talent pool in light of the changing digital landscape. He is passionate about the education sector and serves on the Global Corporate Advisory Board of edX.org, a non-profit online learning enterprise founded by Harvard and MIT.
Education: AMP, Harvard Business School | Bachelors, Economics, Plaksha University
Research_Summary: Chief Executive Officer, Arise Virtual Solutions Inc; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Monik Sameer Koticha
Bio:
Monik Sameer Koticha is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is part of the promoter family of ASK Group.

Monik is also the Managing Director of Fortress Group (family office of Sameer Koticha, Founder and Chairman of ASK Group) and oversees investments in equity, real estate, and private equity for the family office. He is an avid investor with a focus on bottom-up investments.

He is also responsible for overseeing the family and corporate philanthropic initiatives and is actively involved with several causes in the areas of education, housing, and nation building.
Research_Summary: Managing Director, Fortress Group; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Mukesh Sharma
Bio:
Mukesh Sharma is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. As founding Chairman of the IB Continnum school, that offers Cambridge IGSCE and A-levels, Prometheus, Mukesh Sharma is on a mission to reimagine learning, bringing in holistic and affordable education to the country. The extended mission is to provide exposure and opportunities to the school children that have so far been an entitlement just for the affluent. Under Mukesh's visionary leadership, the school has already crossed several milestones.

Alongside Prometheus, Mukesh is also the founder CEO of QA InfoTech Worldwide (now a Qualitest Company), a software services organization focused on quality engineering since 2003. As a serial entrepreneur he has envisioned and bootstrapped several other initiatives including QAIT DevLabs, Perseverance IT Solutions, ItsCredible.com, EduLocker.com, AiTestBanks and Phando, providing a range of products and services, with a focus on commitment and excellence. Given that one of the domains QA InfoTech specializes in is education and learning, the transition to starting Prometheus was an innate alignment for Mukesh, leveraging the bests of both the digital acumen in the educational industry and his passion to drive the change in the educational sector.

Within Affidabile Solutions, ValidateME (aka ItsCredible.com) and EduLocker platforms allow organizations in issuing and distributing mass documents (verified credentials, certificates, badges, etc.) in one click, eliminate verification load, increase social media traffic, and provide a platform, EduLocker, to store all verified documents.

Mukesh holds a Master of Science and Technology in Information Systems from Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani, India, as well as a Master of Engineering in Engineering Management from University of Colorado, Boulder, USA. He is an avid golfer as well as a philanthropist who takes a personal interest in the organization's CSR initiatives that cover a diverse set of causes including education for the underprivileged in India.
Education: MSc, Information Systems, BITS
Research_Summary: Chairman and Director, Prometheus School; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Navin Chaddha
Bio:
Navin Chaddha is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Navin is a serial entrepreneur turned venture capitalist. As a venture capitalist he likes partnering with entrepreneurs who want to change the way people work, live and play. As an entrepreneur, Navin co-founded 3 companies in his 20s, including VXtreme, which was acquired by Microsoft to become Windows Media and iBeam Broadcasting (NASDAQ:IBEM). As a venture capitalist Navin has had the fortune of championing entrepreneurs of over 50 companies in the U.S. and India, 17 of which have gone public and another 20 have been acquired. Some of his past notable investments include IPOs of Akamai (NASDAQ:AKAM), LYFT (NASDAQ: LYFT), Makemytrip (NASDAQ:MMYT), Persistent Systems (NSE:PERSISTENT), Rhythms NetConnections (NASDAQ: RTHM), Solarcity (NASDAQ:SCTY), and acquisitions of Brighter/Cigna, CloudGenix/Palo Alto Networks, CloudSimple/Google, Elastica/Blue Coat/Symantec, Gigya/SAP, Neopath Networks/Cisco, Pulse/LinkedIn, StorSimple/Microsoft, Wichorus/Tellabs and Zenprise/Citrix.

He grew up in India, where he graduated from IIT Delhi, and got his master's from Stanford University. He has been fortunate to be named as a Young Global Leader by the World Economic Forum and has ranked on the Forbes Midas List of Top 100 Tech Investors eleven times.
Education: MS, Electrical Engineering, Stanford University | BTech, Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Managing Partner, Mayfield Fund; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Neeraj Aggarwal
Designation: Vice Chair, Asia Pacific, Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
Bio:
Neeraj Aggarwal is a senior leader at Boston Consulting Group with over 30 years of experience.

Neeraj serves as Vice Chair of the Asia Pacific region for BCG, having previously served as Regional Chair of the Asia Pacific region and as a member of the firm's Global Executive Committee. In this role, he works extensively with clients across Southeast Asia, India, Greater China, South Korea and Australia.

He supports CEOs and Chairs to set their agendas and improve the effectiveness of their organisations. As a thought leader in AI-driven transformation, he supports CEOs in embedding AI into business strategy and operations; leveraging data, people and technology for competitive advantage. He is inspired by clients who challenge conventional wisdom and set new global standards.

Neeraj is passionate about technology and its potential to transform both business and society. He played a critical role in shaping BCG's future in AI as well as its climate and sustainability practice.

Over years, Neeraj has played multiple roles in BCG including leading the India business, global Tech services business and also driving the quest for relationship excellence with clients.

Prior to joining BCG, Neeraj worked at Cadence Design Systems, a Silicon Valley–based electronic design automation firm. He holds a BTech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi, a Master's in Computer Science from The Ohio State University, and an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, where he received the Young Alumni Achiever's Award.

Beyond BCG, Neeraj is a founding leader of Plaksha University, where he serves as Chair of the Board of Trustees. The university seeks to reimagine technology education and undertake transformative research to address grand challenges.

Neeraj is also a TED speaker, where he spoke on the rising power of the East - spotlighting Asia's transformation from an outsourcing hub to a global epicenter of ideas, innovation and leadership shaping every industry worldwide.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | Masters, Computer Science, Ohio State University | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Vice Chair, Asia Pacific, Boston Consulting Group (BCG); Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Niten Malhan
Designation: Founder and Partner, New Mark Advisors LLP
Bio: Niten Malhan is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Niten is the Founder and Partner, New Mark Advisors LLP. He launched the firm in 2018. He was a Managing Director and Co-head of India at Warburg Pincus LLC, where he focused on investment activities in India. He was with Warburg Pincus from 2001. Previously, he was Director of Business Development at Stratum8 Corporation. He also worked as an Engagement Manager with McKinsey and Company in New Delhi, Jakarta, and Boston. He is a Director of Aryan Coal, Dainik Bhaskar, Havells India, and Punj Lloyd. He served as Director of Lemon Tree Hotels Limited until Aug 13, 2018.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | BTech, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founder and Partner, New Mark Advisors LLP; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Nitin Rakesh
Bio:
Nitin Rakesh is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Nitin, a distinguished leader in the IT services industry, joined Mphasis as its CEO and Managing Director in January 2017.

In the first year of taking on the mantle as the CEO of Mphasis, Nitin introduced Mphasis: C= X2C2 =1TM formula for success, (hyper-personalization; drive n=1 powered by Cloud & Cognitive); driving multi-dimensions of business value with an integrated consumer-centric Front2BackTM Digital Transformation, enabling Business Operations, Technology Transformation and Service Transformation, driven by IP assets.

Prior to joining Mphasis, Nitin Rakesh was the CEO and President of Syntel (a NASDAQ listed IT Services Company). Nitin has a proven track record of delivering profitable growth at industry leading operating margins. Before he was appointed as the CEO, he served as President, Americas for Syntel, where he headed Business Development and North American operations. Nitin served at Syntel in various capacities between 2012 and 2016 and between 2002 and 2008.

Nitin is an active member of various institutions globally, such as U.S.-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) driving financial services council and business relations between US and India. He is also on the advisory board of the Knowledge at The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania's driving digital transformation discussions at grass root level.

Nitin holds a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science) from Delhi Institute of Technology, Delhi University and has received his Master's in Management from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai and is also an alumnus of Harvard Business School's CEO Workshop.
Education: CEO Workshop, Harvard Business School | MMS, Finance, NMIMS | Computer Science, Delhi Institute of Technology
Research_Summary: CEO and MD, Mphasis; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Pankaj Chaddah
Bio: Info not available
Education: Mechanical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-founder, Zomato and Shyft; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Pramod Bhasin
Bio: Pramod Bhasin is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Pramod is currently the Chairman of ICRIER, one of India's foremost economic research think tanks. He is also the Co-founder of Asha Impact, a virtual social impact investment fund and advocacy platform. Previously, Pramod founded Genpact, an NYSE listed company, in 1997 and served as the President and CEO until 2011 and is considered the pioneer of the business process management industry. He led GE Capital in India and Asia, with a 25 year career with GE in the US, UK and Asia. He has also built a skills business across India. Pramod currently serves on several boards including DLF Ltd, as well as NGOs such as Help Age India, Vishwas, and Villageways. He serves as a Strategic Advisor to Kedaara, a private equity firm. He was voted IT Man of the Year, and has been the Chairman of Nasscom and TiE-NCR.
Education: CA, ICAI | Bachelors, SRCC
Research_Summary: Chairman, ICRIER | Founder, Genpact; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rajesh Magow
Designation: Co-founder and Group CEO, MakeMyTrip Limited
Bio:
Rajesh Magow is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Rajesh is the Co-founder and Group Chief Executive Officer of MakeMyTrip Limited. He also serves as the Vice Chairman for IAMAI, and Chairperson of ASSOCHAM's National Council on Travel and Tourism.

A believer in India's digital opportunity and a backer of many young Indian tech companies, Rajesh is passionate about transforming businesses and leveraging technology to create disproportionate value for customers.

Over the years, Rajesh has played a crucial role in multiple landmark events of MakeMyTrip, including its listing on NASDAQ in 2010, the merger of MakeMyTrip and Ibibo group, and most recently, played a pivotal role in ensuring MakeMyTrip showed resilience and bounced back stronger post-pandemic.

Rajesh has received multiple industry awards, including being recognized by The Economic Times Human Capital Awards as the People-Focused CEO of the Year and Bloomberg Best CFO Award. Rajesh has served as Director on the board of Flipkart.
Education: Finance, The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
Research_Summary: Co-founder and Group CEO, MakeMyTrip Limited; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rajesh Sachdeva
Designation: Founding Partner, Flowering Tree Investment Management
Bio: Rajesh Sachdeva is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Rajesh has 20+ years of Asian equities experience culminating in the founding of Flowering Tree Investment Management Pte. Ltd (FTIM), in June 2008. FTIM manages an Asia focused long short portfolio with an emphasis on Return on Invested Capital and quality of management teams. Before FTIM, Rajesh co-founded Sansar Capital in 2005. In addition to FTIM and Sansar Capital, he has worked in senior buy side investing roles covering Asia at Kingdon Capital and Alliance Capital. He has also worked on the sell-side with a focus on Asia with Citigroup, Credit Agricole Indosuez, Natwest and ICICI Securities (JP Morgan India JV). Rajesh has had a passion for investing since a very early age.
Education: PGDBM, Finance and Marketing, XLRI Jamshedpur | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founding Partner, Flowering Tree Investment Management; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rajiv Kuchhal
Bio: Rajiv Kuchhal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Rajiv is an active angel investor and mentor to multiple startups in the social enterprise and technology space. He is an Advisor and Board Member of many such companies. He is also a general partner at the Exfinity fund. Rajiv has spent more than 2 decades in IT/BPO industry, mainly with Infosys group. He led Infosys' foray into telecom and product engineering services space in the early '90s. He became one of the youngest Business Heads and Management Council members at Infosys. He led Infosys' foray into BPO as a founding team member of Progeon (now Infosys BPO). He was Chief Operating Officer of OnMobile and was part of the senior management team instrumental in helping OnMobile scale as an organization and consolidate its market leadership. Rajiv is a graduate from IIT Delhi.
Research_Summary: General Partner, Exfinity Venture Fund

Name: Rajiv Ramnarayan
Designation: Co-founder and CEO, Equentia Natural Resources Pte Ltd
Bio:
Rajiv Ramnarayan is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. He is a seasoned entrepreneur and business leader with deep expertise in logistics, international trade, mining, and fintech-driven supply chain finance. He is the Co-founder and CEO of Equentia Natural Resources Pte Ltd, a Singapore-based company he established in 2010. Under his leadership, Equentia has grown into a prominent player in the sourcing, logistics, and trade finance of thermal and coking coal across Southeast and South Asia.

In addition to his role at Equentia, Rajiv is a founding member and Independent Director at CredAble, a leading fintech platform based in Mumbai. Since its inception in 2017, CredAble has been transforming the landscape of supply chain finance in India by offering innovative, tech-enabled financing solutions.

Rajiv's career began at IBM in 2002 as an Industrial Trainee, where he worked on enterprise-level workflow automation. He later took on business development roles at Laing O'Rourke, focusing on IT-enabled facility management, before becoming a Partner at Doehle Danautic Logistics. There, he gained hands-on experience in international logistics, commercial negotiation, and end-to-end supply chain operations.
Education: BEng Hons, Electronic Engineering, Sheffield Hallam University, UK
Research_Summary: Co-founder and CEO, Equentia Natural Resources Pte Ltd; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rakesh Jaggi
Bio:
"Education is not the learning of the facts but the training of the mind to think." – Albert Einstein

Rakesh Jaggi is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Based in Houston, Rakesh is the senior VP for Sales and Commercial at Schlumberger Oilfield Services, a position he assumed in May 2019. In the past, he has held several management roles including President, Completions from March 2017 to April 2019, Vice President, Technology Lifecycle Management (TLM) from August 2015 to March 2017, Vice President, Sustaining from March 2013 to July 2015 and President, Schlumberger Well Intervention Services from January 2012 to February 2013. Rakesh began his Schlumberger career with field assignments in India, Trinidad & Tobago and Colombia followed by field management roles in Trinidad & Tobago and Mexico. He was then assigned to leadership positions including Vice President of Wireline Operations in North and South America, Vice President and General Manager of Schlumberger India Operations, Vice President of Well Services in Middle East and Asia regions and Global Vice President of New Businesses.

A founder and trustee of Ashoka University, he graduated in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Delhi and joined Schlumberger in 1992. He has a keen interest in sports, especially cricket, table tennis and golf. He is keen on Indian music in general (particularly ghazals) and Indian poetry too. He believes in teamwork, and nothing pleases him more than seeing a team of individuals with different backgrounds, cultures, ways and beliefs work on a project and always come up with something much better than anyone individually on the team would have. He is sure Plaksha will demonstrate this too. Besides, on the personal front, Rakesh and his wife, Anuradha, are presently grappling with the challenges of keeping up with the dynamic music tastes of their two daughters and adapting to an empty nest.
Education: BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: President Digital Integration, Schlumberger; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rashi Mehta
Designation: Founder and Chair, Iron Lady Foundation
Bio:
Rashi Mehta is a global entrepreneur and philanthropy leader whose work spans technology, education, women's leadership and community empowerment. She co-founded Rahi Systems and played a central role in growing it from a small Silicon Valley startup into an international technology company operating in more than 25 countries before its acquisition by Wesco, a Fortune 200 organization.

A passionate advocate for women and youth, Rashi studied Executive Coaching at UC Berkeley and has coached CEOs, CFOs and senior leaders across major industries. She further deepened her expertise in systems change and strategic philanthropy through programs at Stanford PACS and the Centre for Strategic Philanthropy.

Rashi serves on the Board of Make-A-Wish Foundation Greater Bay Area.

In 2024, Rashi founded Iron Lady Foundation in memory of her mother, Dr Leela Mehta, a pioneering gynecologist whose life of service inspired generations. The ethos of Iron Lady Foundation is rooted in a simple belief: every woman and every child deserves dignity, opportunity and the chance to rise. Through education, healthcare, clean water, sanitation and women's economic empowerment, the Foundation is creating community-led pathways that uplift women, strengthen families and spark long-lasting generational change.

Rashi's philosophy is grounded in one powerful truth: strong women do more than lead, they redefine generations.
Education: Accounting, Business and Financial Analyst, University of California, Berkeley | Certificate of Business Excellence, Finance and Business Acumen, University of California, Berkeley | Executive Coaching, University of California, Berkeley | Integrating Philanthropy and Investing, Stanford PACS
Research_Summary: Founder and Chair, Iron Lady Foundation; Founding Circle Member, GivingPi; Board of Directors, Make-A-Wish Foundation; Leadership Circle Member, Neythri; Chairperson of the Board, Gruve Inc; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Rimy Oberoi
Bio:
Rimy Oberoi is a Founder and Trustee at Plaksha University. Rimy is passionate about building employability solutions. Currently, she is Director, Centre for Employability Research, a nonprofit aimed to build and deploy innovative models for improving employability in India. It collaborates with educational institutions in the implementation of these innovation models. She also volunteers as Chair at TiE's Young Entrepreneurs Program (Delhi NCR Chapter).

She believes that students are primed for learning through application and that currently, 75 percent of students coming out of the existing education system are unemployable. Through her work she is creating an application-based learning methodology that will complement classroom teaching. She has spent a large part of her professional career developing solutions to alleviate this problem.

She completed her education from the Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai (HR and LR). Rimy has over 24 years of extensive experience in FMCG, Product IT and IT Services. She has been associated with organizations such as HUL, Adobe India and Oyster Learning.
Education: MBA, Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai
Research_Summary: Founder, The Employability Foundation; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ritesh Malik
Bio:
"Two roads diverged in the woods, and I took the one less taken and that has made all the difference." – R Frost

Ritesh Malik is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Ritesh is a physician-turned-entrepreneur who has spent the last decade building companies, backing founders, and shaping institutions at the intersection of India's economic transformation. Trained as a physician, Ritesh transitioned into entrepreneurship in 2015 when he founded Innov8 Coworking, a Y Combinator-backed startup (Summer 2016) that reimagined flexible workspaces in India. Under his leadership, Innov8 scaled to more than 60 locations nationwide, becoming one of India's most prominent co-working platforms before its acquisition by SoftBank-backed OYO, one of the notable exits in India's startup ecosystem.

Following his exit, Ritesh shifted toward long-term capital allocation through his family office, The Mangrove Holdings, which oversees a diversified portfolio spanning public equities, early- and growth-stage startups, operating businesses, and real estate. The family office has backed over 125 startups across mobility, aerospace, deep tech, consumer brands, health tech, cybersecurity, and media including Ather Energy, Agnikul Cosmos, Blue Tokai, Inito, Safe Security, STAGE, The Viral Fever, and Nothing. He positions himself as an operator-backed capital partner, bringing strategic insight, governance depth, and long-term alignment to founders.

In parallel, Ritesh operates wholly owned businesses close to his roots: Radix Healthcare, a healthcare platform in New Delhi, and Anardana Hospitality, a contemporary Indian dining venture. Beyond commerce, Ritesh invests in institutions built to outlast individuals. He serves on the Advisory Board of MIT's Kuo Sharper Center for Prosperity and Entrepreneurship and on the board of Netaji Subhas University of Technology, New Delhi.

He is deeply engaged in policy as Founder, Director, and Executive Council Member of the Alliance of Digital India Foundation (ADIF), a not-for-profit representing India's digital startups in regulatory matters. In philanthropy, he is a part of the founding circle of Accelerate India Philanthropy (AIP), encouraging structured giving among Indian family offices, with interests spanning education reform, cybersecurity awareness, startup policy, and accessible healthcare.

Across his roles as founder, capital allocator, operator, board member, and philanthropist, Ritesh's work reflects a deliberate shift from building companies to building ecosystems combining capital, governance, and conviction to support the next generation of innovators.

Ritesh is based in New Delhi and is a World Economic Forum Young Global Leader (Class of 2022).
Education: MBBS, Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery, Dr. MGR Medical University, Tamil Nadu
Research_Summary: Founder and CEO, Innov8 Coworking; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sachit Ahuja
Bio: Sachit Ahuja is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Sachit is a Co-president at Tillman Global Holdings, an owner-operator of digital infrastructure businesses, where he leads Investments and Strategy for the firm. Sachit is a Co-founder and board director of several of its portfolio companies, including Tillman Infrastructure, Tillman Digital Cities and Tillman Networks. Previously, Sachit worked at the Raine Group, a merchant bank focused on TMT, sports and entertainment. Sachit holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics with concentrations in Management and Finance from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and received his MBA from Harvard Business School.
Education: MBA, Harvard Business School | BS, Economics, The Wharton School
Research_Summary: Co-President, Tillman Global Holdings; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sameer Shetty
Designation: Group Executive - Digital Business and Transformation (DBAT) and Strategic Programs, Axis Bank
Bio:
Sameer Shetty is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Sameer serves as the Group Executive for Digital Business and Transformation and Strategic Programs at Axis Bank. In this capacity, he oversees the bank's digital business, strategy, investments, mergers and acquisitions, the customer experience program Sparsh, strategic projects, process excellence, artificial intelligence, and subsidiary governance.

Prior to joining Axis Bank in 2019, Sameer was a Partner at McKinsey and Co., specializing in the financial services sector. His experience includes collaboration with banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), and other financial institutions across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.

Sameer is a director on the Boards of Freecharge Payment Technologies Private Limited, Freecharge Business and Technology Services Limited, and the Indian Banks' Digital Infrastructure Company (IBDIC). Additionally, he is a member of the NPCI Innovation Council and the Governing Committee of Sahamati.

Sameer holds a Bachelor of Technology from IIT Bombay and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIM Bangalore, where he was recognized on the Directors Merit List.
Education: BTech, IIT Bombay | PGDM, IIM Bengaluru
Research_Summary: Group Executive - Digital Business and Transformation (DBAT) and Strategic Programs, Axis Bank; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sanjay Kukreja
Bio:
Sanjay Kukreja is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Sanjay joined ChrysCapital in 2000 and has been a Partner since 2012. He currently serves as the Chief Investment Officer. Before his CIO role, he led the Financial Services and Business Services sectors, overseeing investments of over USD 1.5 billion and realizations of nearly USD 3 billion. Kukreja has played a vital role in high-profile investments and exits for ChrysCapital.

Currently, he sits on the boards of Hero Fincorp, GeBBS Healthcare Solutions, Infogain, and Intas Pharmaceuticals. In the past, Sanjay has served on the boards of KPIT Technologies, LiquidHub, and Shriram Transport Finance Company.

He holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, and a bachelor's degree in economics from Shriram College of Commerce, Delhi University.
Education: MBA, IIM Bengaluru | Shriram College of Commerce(Economics), Delhi University
Research_Summary: Partner and CIO, ChrysCapital; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Saurabh Mittal
Bio:
Saurabh Mittal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Saurabh is a self-made billionaire entrepreneur and investor with a hands-on strategic value-add approach. He is the Founder and Chairman of Mission Holdings, his private global investment holding company. Saurabh partners with world-class entrepreneurs going after multibillion-dollar opportunities and helps them achieve massive scale with both capital and strategic value-add. Some of his portfolio holdings include ONE Championship (Asia's largest sports media property with a global broadcast to 1 billion potential viewers across 118 countries), Incedo (a USD 100 million data and analytics company with 2,000 employees), BSI Financial (a substantial fintech player in the multi-trillion-dollar mortgage industry), SelfScore, and many other companies across a wide spectrum of industries and geographies. Prior to Mission Holdings, he was a senior partner at Noonday, an affiliate of Farallon Capital Management, one of the world's largest hedge funds, where he was responsible for large public and private investments in the areas of Financial Services and Technology, Media, and Telecom (TMT).

Saurabh also was a Founder of Indiabulls, India's leading financial services and real estate conglomerate, and through the partnership with Farallon, helped the business achieve massive scale and success. Saurabh holds an MBA from Harvard Business School, where he graduated as a Baker Scholar. He holds a BS in electrical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology in Delhi, where he was the Best Graduating Student. He is also a member of multiple boards, including the Harvard Business School Alumni Board and Paarivar, a leading charitable organization running India's largest residential school for destitute children.
Education: MBA, Harvard Business School | BS, Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Chairman and Founder, Mission Holdings; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: SK Jain
Designation: Founder and Managing Partner, RatnaTraya Capital
Bio:
"Three Key Ingredients for Success – Belief, Knowledge and Action"

Surendra Kumar (SK) Jain is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. SK is the Founder and Managing Partner of RatnaTraya Capital, a principal personal investing firm. SK was also the Co-founder and Managing Director of WestBridge Capital India and Sequoia Capital India. SK is passionate about higher education initiatives and is also part of the founding group at Ashoka University, IIT Delhi Endowment Fund and IIMA Endowment Fund. SK holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, where he received the President's Gold Medal for Academic Excellence. He also holds an MSEE from the University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, and a BTech in Electrical Engineering from IIT Delhi.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | MS, University of Minnesota | BTech, IIT Delhi
