Research_Summary: Founder and Managing Partner, RatnaTraya Capital; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Srikanth Velamakanni
Designation: Co-founder, Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice Chairman, Fractal
Bio:
Srikanth Velamakanni is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Srikanth is the Co-founder, Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice Chairman of Fractal. Fractal is a leading player in the artificial intelligence and transformative enterprise decision-making space. Fractal's mission is to power every human decision in the enterprise and to use the power of AI to help the world's most admired Fortune 100 companies. Since Srikanth co-founded Fractal in 2000, the company has raised more than USD 300 million from institutional private equity investors. Fractal serves more than 100 Fortune 500 companies with its AI, data, and analytics-driven business strategies. Under his leadership, Fractal has developed several product lines within the company, including Cuddle.ai, Eugenie.ai and Qure.ai. Srikanth is the Chair of the board of Qure.ai, a leading healthcare AI company that is playing a pivotal role in diagnosing and treating diseases like tuberculosis and COVID-19.

As a member of the NASSCOM Executive Council, Srikanth serves as a subject matter expert on data and AI. His passion for AI and analytics has made him a thought leader in the space and an admired public speaker. Srikanth considers himself a lifelong student of mathematics, behavioral economics, neuroscience and consumer behavior.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | BS, Electrical Engineering, Delhi University
Research_Summary: Co-founder, Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice Chairman, Fractal; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sujeet Kumar
Bio: Sujeet Kumar is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Sujeet is a Co-founder of Udaan. He founded Udaan in 2016 with Vaibhav Gupta and Amod Malviya, who were both former senior executives at Flipkart. Prior to founding Udaan, Sujeet was President of Operations at Flipkart, where he built operations, supply chain, and logistics, which accounted for more than half of Flipkart's sales. He was instrumental in setting up the backbone of the distribution network of e-commerce in India.
Education: BTech, Civil Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-founder, Udaan.com; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sumita Ambasta
Designation: Co-founder and Executive Director, Flowering Tree
Bio:
"All learning begins with humility, and ends when we put it to purposeful action"

Sumita Ambasta is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Sumita has pursued a lifelong interest in education and human development. She has founded and leads Flowering Tree, Inc., a US-based foundation that supports children's education and women's development in Asia. The foundation has worked on grassroots education and development in India for the last fifteen years. She has helped incubate startups and has lifelong experience in the role of human resources in the fields of finance, technology, and entrepreneurship. She has mentored several women entrepreneurs and supports women in taking leadership roles.

She works in the US, Singapore, and India and has exposure to cross-cultural issues, policy, and research in these areas. As a commitment to lifelong learning, she is currently pursuing a doctoral degree in Education at Teachers College, Columbia University. She has also undertaken studies in filmmaking and Hindustani classical music. She has raised two children in multicultural and multilingual settings. She is frequently invited to write and speak on topics of education, development, and leadership.
Education: Ed.M., Columbia University | MBA HR, XLRI | MA Sociology, Jawaharlal Nehru University | B.Sc. Hons. Physics, Presidency College
Research_Summary: Co-founder and Executive Director, Flowering Tree; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Sunny Gupta
Research_Summary: General Partner, Generative Capital; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Ursheet Parikh
Bio:
Ursheet Parikh is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Ursheet co-leads Mayfield's Engineering Biology investment practice where Mayfield invests in companies transforming human and planetary health. Ursheet also invests in Enterprise IT infrastructure companies.

His investments in engineering biology and healthcare include Mammoth Biosciences (CRISPR), Mission Bio (Single Cell Sequencing, Oncology), Qventus (Healthcare AI), Endpoint Health (New treatments for ICU), Nēsos (Immunology, Neurology) and an unannounced company in precision diagnostics for maternal and fetal health.

His investments in the enterprise IT sector include Versa Networks (Security and SD-WAN), ShiftLeft (Application Security), Rancher Labs (Cloud Computing platform acquired by SUSE), CloudGenix (SD-WAN platform acquired by Palo Alto Networks) and Netsil (Application Observability platform acquired by Nutanix).

Prior to Mayfield, Ursheet had an operating career as a proven repeat entrepreneur and executive at Cisco and Microsoft. Ursheet was Co-founder and CEO of StorSimple - the leading cloud-integrated storage company that was acquired by Microsoft in 2012.

Ursheet holds an MBA from the Wharton School and a Bachelor's in Computer Science from the Indian Institute of Technology in Mumbai, from which he received the Young Alumni Achiever award in 2015.

Ursheet is passionate about accelerating healthcare innovation and transforming college education where his family foundation is focused.
Education: MBA, Wharton School | BTech, IIT Bombay
Research_Summary: Partner, Mayfield Fund; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Vikas Khemani
Designation: Founder and CIO, Carnelian Asset Management and Advisors Pvt Ltd
Bio:
Vikas Khemani is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Vikas has 25 years of experience in capital markets and financial services. Before founding Carnelian, he was CEO of Edelweiss Securities Ltd, where he spent 17 years incubating and building several businesses to leadership positions, including Institutional Equities, Investment Banking and Equity Research.

Vikas is a passionate leader with a keen interest in building scale businesses, investing, nurturing talent, and building leaders. He has a deep interest in psychology, spirituality, fitness, politics and policy. Vikas runs marathons and practices vipassana.

He has been associated with several industry bodies and committees, including the CII National Council on Corporate Governance, FICCI Capital Markets Committee, and Executive Council of Bombay Management Association. He is also a member of Young Presidents' Organization (YPO), a global forum for entrepreneurs and CEOs. He was awarded Young Professional Achievers Award for the service sector by ICAI in 2014.
Research_Summary: Founder and CIO, Carnelian Asset Management and Advisors Pvt Ltd; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Vikrant Bhargava
Bio:
Vikrant Bhargava is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. Vikrant is the Founder and Trustee of Veddis, a multi-asset investment company. He was previously Co-founder and Marketing Director of PartyGaming Plc, where he spearheaded the company's growth from a startup in 2000 to a FTSE 100 business at its IPO on the London Stock Exchange in 2005.

After stepping down from PartyGaming, Vikrant has been an active investor and mentor to technology startups, while also building a geographically diverse, real estate investment business at Veddis.

Vikrant tries to spend approximately half his working time on philanthropic activities. In addition to supporting multiple high-impact initiatives via the Veddis Foundation in the UK and India, Vikrant is passionate about transforming high school children's relationship with STEM. In 2018, he founded FIRST UK (FIRSTUK.org), a high growth organization that aims to equip the next generation with the technical knowledge and core life skills needed to tackle tomorrow's challenges using robotics.

He is also the Chairman of Founders Pledge, an organization that works closely with entrepreneurs to help maximize the impact of their giving.

He is an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (1994) and Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (1996).
Education: MBA, IIM Calcutta | BTech, Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Founder and Trustee, Veddis Foundation; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Vineet Nayyar
Bio: Vineet is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. In a career spanning over 40 years, Vineet has worked with the Government of India, international multilateral agencies and in the corporate sector (both public and private). Vineet started his career with the Indian Administrative Service and held a series of senior positions, including that of a District Magistrate, Secretary, Agriculture and Rural Development for the Government of Haryana and Director, Department of Economic Affairs, Government of India. He has also worked with the World Bank for 10 years in a series of assignments as the Chief for the Energy, Infrastructure, and Finance Divisions for East Asia and Pacific. He was the founding Chairman and Managing Director of the state-owned Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) and has served as the Managing Director of HCL Corporation Ltd. and Vice Chairman of HCL Technologies Ltd. He was also a Founder and Chief Executive Officer of HCL Perot Systems. Vineet was awarded the Ernst and Young – Entrepreneur of the Year [Manager] award in 2013.
Education: Masters, Development Economics, Williams College, Massachusetts
Research_Summary: Former Executive Vice-Chairman, Tech Mahindra; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Vishal Tulsyan
Designation: Executive Chairman, MO Alternate Investment Advisors
Bio:
Vishal Tulsyan is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Vishal founded MO Alternates in 2006 with Motilal Oswal Group as its sponsor. Under his leadership, MO Alternates has become one of the most reputed alternates platforms in India with over USD 2 billion in assets under management. Over the years, many companies backed by MO Alternates have become multi-billion-dollar enterprises.

Before MO Alternates, Vishal has spent over two decades in the financial services sector across private equity, investment banking, and structured finance in organizations such as Rabobank. He is a Chartered Accountant and a graduate from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. On the philanthropic front, Vishal is part of many initiatives. He is the Co-founder of Abhiyan Bharat Foundation, an education trust that helps children get an education they deserve and not what they can afford. He is one of the core founders of Accelerate India Philanthropy, a platform by and for philanthropists with a mission to inspire, influence, and inform strategic giving. Additionally, he is involved with Global Parli, an initiative that works with farmers to increase their overall farm income through cropping patterns, training, and cluster plantation.
Research_Summary: Executive Chairman, MO Alternate Investment Advisors; Founder and Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Vivek Khare
Designation: General Partner, SamVed VC Strategic Advisor, LetsVenture
Bio:
Vivek Khare is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Vivek Khare is a General Partner at SamVed VC, where he focuses on helping early-stage startups achieve market validation. He actively supports entrepreneurs in hiring, customer prioritization and overcoming initial scaling challenges.

Prior to SamVed VC, Vivek held key leadership positions at Info Edge India Ltd., where he served as Executive Vice President for Corporate Development. He was instrumental in shaping the company's investment strategy and played a pivotal role in early-stage funding for successful startups like Zomato, PolicyBazaar, and MeritNation. His tenure also included leading Jeevansathi.com as Business Head and serving as Senior VP of Technology at Naukri.com.

Vivek is an active angel investor and mentor, backing startups across multiple sectors, including consumer internet, fintech, and SaaS. He has invested in and advised companies such as Nivesh.com, Cashify, Happily Unmarried, Jaypore, and MEDdelivery. His passion for supporting founders extends to his role as a Strategic Advisor at LetsVenture.
Education: M.Sc, IIT Kanpur
Research_Summary: General Partner, SamVed VC Strategic Advisor, LetsVenture; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University; Strategic Advisor, LetsVenture

Name: Vivek Vaidya
Designation: Co-founder and General Partner, super{set} startup studio
Bio:
Vivek Vaidya is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Vivek is a serial entrepreneur and technology leader who has built industry-leading technology companies in enterprise software, data management, analytics, and machine learning and AI over the last 25 years. Currently, he is the Founder, General Partner, and CTO of Super{set}, a startup studio that funds and builds data-driven technology companies. Prior to forming Super{set}, Vivek was the CTO of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, having joined Salesforce via the acquisition of Krux, a mar-tech platform that he co-founded with Tom Chavez in 2010. Before Krux, Vivek served as the CTO of Rapt, a provider of software for media monetization acquired by Microsoft in 2008.

Vivek holds an MS in Mathematics and Computer Applications from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and an MS in Computer Science from the University of Denver. While at IIT Delhi, he was an early member of the team at Parsec Technologies, the first company to build and market Interactive Voice Response systems in India. Vivek lives in San Francisco with his wife Pallavi and son Viplav and is a co-author of Data-Driven: Harnessing Data and AI to Reinvent Customer Engagement, published in 2018.
Education: MS Computer Science, University of Denver | M.Sc. Mathematics & Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Co-founder and General Partner, super{set} startup studio; Founder & Trustee, Plaksha University

Name: Alok Goyal
Bio:
Alok is a Founder of Plaksha University. When Alok is not busy being involved with investment projects in SaaS, logistics, and automotive, he can often be seen ensuring the adequate supply of much-adored snacks in the office premises and, of course, seeing to it that the fun levels at work never drop below optimum levels. His interest in venture capital stems from the energy he derives from meetings with entrepreneurs. Moreover, he strongly believes that to be an entrepreneur, one needs to be a dreamer and indeed be foolish (read courageous) enough to pursue the dream. According to Alok, the ability to pursue one's dreams in an unfettered way is what makes entrepreneurs truly special, and so, he believes that there is something to be learned from every entrepreneur.

Alok's previous endeavors included leading enterprise software and outsourcing investments at Helion, where he invested in Whatfix, Axtria, Pipemonk (ACQD: Freshdesk) and Linguanext (ACQD: Fidel Technologies). In addition, Alok was previously involved in various leadership roles at SAP in India and the US, as well as a series of roles at Siebel Systems, The McKenna Group, McKinsey and Company, and Cadence Design Systems. As far as his hobbies are concerned, he writes a weekly blog on mathematical puzzles (alokgoyal1971.com) and dabbles in light and classical Hindustani music. He is a passionate foodie as well (hence chief in charge of the snacks supply), and is maniacal about fitness.
Education: MBA, INSEAD | MS, The University of Texas, Austin | BTech, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Partner, Stellaris Venture Partners; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Alok Ramsisaria
Bio:
Alok Ramsisaria is a Founder of Plaksha University. Alok Ramsisaria is the CEO of Grazitti Interactive, where he leads the company's strategy across marketing, sales, and customer success. Grazitti is a bootstrapped digital innovation company helping global businesses transform customer experience through marketing automation, communities, analytics, and AI.

With over 35 years of experience across technology, marketing, and consulting, Alok has scaled Grazitti from its inception in India into a global organization of over a thousand people—without external funding. He believes in AI as a multiplier for talent, enabling teams to deliver greater impact rather than replacing them.

He focuses on building scalable systems and high-performance teams, driving consistent, year-on-year growth while serving global enterprises. Alok is also a Co-founder of Chandigarh Angels Network (CAN), an early-stage angel network that supports and mentors startups across North India.
Education: BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi | MS, UNC Chapel Hill
Research_Summary: CEO, Grazitti Interactive; Founder, Plaksha University; Co-founder, Chandigarh Angels Network

Education: BTech, Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Delhi | PhD, Computer Science, Georgia Institute of Technology
Research_Summary: Co-founder and CEO, Immersa.ai; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Ananda Sen Gupta
Education: MBA, IIM Calcutta | BTech, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Vice President, Nagarro; Founder, Trackmybeat; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Ashish Gupta
Bio:
"Focus on the Process - outcomes will follow eventually."

Dr Ashish Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. He is a Founder of Helion Venture Partners and serves on several boards, including Hindustan Unilever, Info Edge (Naukri), Pubmatic, Simplilearn, and Workspot. Prior to Helion, he co-founded two successful companies - Junglee (AMZN) and Tavant Technologies. He also worked at Woodside Fund, Oracle, and IBM. His other investments include Daksh (IBM), MMYT, MuSigma, UPWK, Flipkart (Walmart), and Perfios. Ashish enjoys working with startups with a particular interest in product and leadership. Ashish is a Kauffman Fellow, holds a PhD from Stanford University, and a BTech from IIT Kanpur, where he was awarded the President's Gold Medal and later nominated to the list of 50 notable alumni.
Education: PhD, Computer Science, Stanford University | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Kanpur
Research_Summary: Senior Managing Director, Helion Ventures; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Ashish Kumar
Bio: Ashish Kumar is a Founder of Plaksha University. Ashish Kumar is the Managing Partner and CIO at Infinity Alternatives. Prior to founding Infinity Alternatives, Ashish was the India Head for PineBridge Investments. He has also worked at Bank of America. Ashish has a BTech from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
Research_Summary: Managing Partner, Infinity Alternatives; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Brijesh Agarwal
Designation: Co-founder and Director, IndiaMART InterMESH Limited
Bio: Brijesh Agarwal is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha. A vital part of the core management team, Brijesh has been the driving force behind the creation of a plethora of innovative products at IndiaMART. Possessing a dynamic, intriguing, and exciting leadership style, he is known for steadily introducing eclectic strategies aimed at the growth of different verticals of the organization. Currently, Brijesh is spearheading Tolexo.com, a 100% subsidiary of IndiaMART, providing a seamless shopping experience for the largest collection of products needed by businesses, factories, offices, and laboratories. Being a relationship-oriented leader, Brijesh plays a key role in aligning people and has inspired many professionals to excel in their respective fields. A management graduate from The University of Lucknow and an MBA from The National Institute of Integrated Learning and Management (NIILM), he is a sports lover, especially cricket.

Name: Carl George Dürschmidt
Designation: Chairperson of the Supervisory Board, Nagarro
Bio: Carl George Dürschmidt is a Founder of Plaksha University. Carl George Dürschmidt, who spreads his time between Germany and South Africa, is a long-time investor and recent farmer. He is the Chair of the Supervisory Board of Nagarro and, separately, of Allgeier, and is effectively the largest shareholder in both companies. After studying business economics, Carl first worked for the family business. In 1986, he joined an international business consultancy, where he was in charge of the strategic advisory to small and medium-sized enterprises. From 1989, he worked for an investment company that mainly developed participations in German SMEs. After an IPO of one of these companies, he joined the Executive Board in 1992. Then, after founding a private investment company together with partners, he was responsible for the development and management of a portfolio of SMEs. He took an equity participation in Allgeier over 15 years ago and ran the company as CEO until 2021.
Research_Summary: Chairperson of the Supervisory Board, Nagarro; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Deepak Goyal
Designation: Managing Director and Senior Partner, Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
Bio:
Deepak Goyal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Deepak is a Managing Director and Senior Partner at Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and a core member of the firm's Financial Institutions and Marketing, Sales and Pricing practices. He globally leads BCG's Fintech segment and has previously led the Wholesale Banking practice in North America, as well as the Marketing, Sales, and Pricing practice in Financial Institutions worldwide.

Since joining BCG in 2004, Deepak has advised global clients on strategy, pricing, operations, IT, organization design and large-scale business transformation. His expertise spans wholesale banking, corporate finance, revenue management and people strategy.

Before joining BCG, Deepak worked at McKinsey in India, where he developed a deep understanding of financial institutions and market dynamics. With a strong background in strategy and execution, he continues to shape the future of financial services through data-driven insights and transformative business solutions.
Education: MBA, Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad | BTech, Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi
Research_Summary: Managing Director and Senior Partner, Boston Consulting Group (BCG); Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Devashish Chopra
Research_Summary: Partner, Wellington Management; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Dilipkumar Khandelwal
Designation: Managing Director and CEO, Deutsche India
Bio: Dilipkumar Khandelwal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Dilip is the Managing Director and CEO of Deutsche India. He is also the Global Chief Information Officer for Corporate Functions Technology at Deutsche Bank. He is a proven leader with over 20 years of experience running large technology organizations. Prior to Deutsche Bank, Dilip was the Global Head and President of the SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud business. During his tenure as Managing Director, SAP India was rated #1 in the 'Great Place to Work' ranking. He is an Advisory Board member at the Indian Institute of Information Technology and is an Executive Council member at NASSCOM. He has been an advisor in venture capital and private equity firms. His strength in driving innovation and his entrepreneurial mindset have allowed him to follow his passion for mentoring startups and acting as an angel investor to multiple companies like Whatfix, Yellow.ai, Moglix, and Mamaearth. Dilip is a graduate in Engineering from Mumbai University and holds a Management degree from the Indian School of Business and has been awarded the 40 Under 40 Award by The Economic Times.
Education: Global Leadership Program, INSEAD | MBA, Indian School of Business | Bachelor of Engineering, VESIT, University of Mumbai
Research_Summary: Managing Director and CEO, Deutsche India; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Guru Pangal
Education: MS, Utah State University
Research_Summary: GM Storage, Google Cloud; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Jitendra Gupta
Bio:
Jitendra Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Jitendra is founder of Amica Financial (Jupiter). He aims to create a mobile-first banking experience for Indian millennials. The idea is to create a savvy and cost-effective banking experience and at the same time help youth manage their money better. Before Jupiter, Jitendra founded LazyPay and was MD of PayU India. Prior to PayU, he had founded Citrus Pay, a leading digital payments company in India. The same was sold to Naspers in Sep 2016 for USD 130 million in one of the most successful fintech exits. He has more than 16 years of work experience in the banking and financial services industry and is considered an expert in the payments industry. Prior to Citrus, he was working with ICICI Bank for 7 years, wherein he was part of the founding team of retail cross-sell and investment banking division in the bank. During his last stint with the bank, he led the whole initiative of stitching a joint venture between ICICI Bank and First Data in the Indian market. This was a unique JV ever done between a bank and an independent payments company.

In 4 years, he had grown Citrus into a 300-member+ strong team and raised over USD 25 million. Citrus counts its investor base from Sequoia Capital and E-context Japan to Ascent Capital in Series C round. In 2016, Citrus was sold to Naspers in one of the largest fintech exits in India. He has graduated from Sydenham College, Mumbai and is a qualified Chartered Accountant. He also created the pay later brand LazyPay and scaled it to more than 1 million active consumers using the brand on a monthly basis.

Kaushal was instrumental in creating the investment banking business at Avendus, leveraging his expertise in financial strategy, capital markets and advisory services. Name: Krish Mantripragada
Designation: Chief Product and Technology Officer, Seismic
Bio:
"The best way to predict the future is to create it"

Krish Mantripragada is a Founder of Plaksha University. Krish is an innovative and entrepreneurial senior executive who has spent over two decades building software solutions at multiple pioneering and leading companies. Over his career he has helped create new product categories, scale businesses, build teams from the ground up and had two successful IPOs (Medallia (NYSE: MDLA) and First Data (NYSE: FDC)).

Krish currently serves as the Chief Product and Technology Officer of Seismic, global enterprise SaaS leader in enablement with over 2,000 organizations worldwide trusting its award-winning Seismic Enablement Cloud™ to enable teams and ignite revenue growth. In his role, he is responsible for R&D (Product, Design, Engineering, Support and Operations) and Product Marketing. Previously, Krish was EVP and Chief Product Officer of Medallia where he was responsible for the vision, roadmap and delivery of all products and solutions, leading to its successful IPO on NYSE in 2019. Medallia is a pioneer in customer experience management with over a thousand of the world's leading brands leveraging Medallia Experience Cloud™, a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform, to win through customer experience. Previously, he was SVP and GM of Information and Analytics Solutions at First Data. He was part of the leadership team that turned the company around and took it public in 2015.

Previously, Krish held several leadership positions at SAP, i2 Technologies, Agile Software and United Technologies Research. He has more than 20 years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, analytics and cloud applications and has built several multi-million-dollar product businesses over his career. Krish lives in Silicon Valley, CA with his wife and two kids. He is an active investor, mentor and advisor to several startups.

Name: Manipal Dhariwal
Bio:

Under his leadership, Netsmartz has been ranked among the top 100 fastest-growing companies in Rochester, New York.

Over the past 26 years, Manipal has built a distinguished footprint in the global IT ecosystem. In addition to founding multiple award-winning technology companies—including Netsmartz, CloudSmartz, Sebiz Infotech, Caresmartz, DynamicsSmartz, Envision Ecommerce, and APPWorx—he actively supports a portfolio of more than 20 startups across the world.

A first-generation serial entrepreneur, he is passionate about transforming startups into scale-ups. He has driven business investments of over USD 100 million in Northern India and has been instrumental in creating more than 1,500 direct jobs and approximately 3,500 indirect jobs.

He is the Founder and Chapter President of the Startup Accelerator Chamber of Commerce (SACC), a member of YPO and EO, Advisor to TEDx Chandigarh, Chairman of the IT and ITES Entrepreneurship/Startup Committee (ASSOCHAM), Charter Member of TiE, and President of the Mohali IT City Association. He collaborates actively with institutions across India to strengthen and accelerate the country's startup ecosystem.

Beyond entrepreneurship, Manipal is an avid golfer and a committed philanthropist. His social impact efforts focus on promoting entrepreneurship, supporting social causes and community development, and driving sustainability and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

Name: Manish Krishnan
Bio:
Manish Krishnan is a seasoned entrepreneur, investor, and advisor, currently serving as a Senior Advisor at Nagarro, a digital product engineering firm listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. Previously, he was Managing Director at Nagarro. In 2021, Nagarro acquired ATCS Inc., a global IT consulting firm founded by Manish. ATCS delivers digital and analytics solutions to Fortune 500 clients across pharmaceuticals, healthcare, finance, and automotive sectors, with offices in six countries.

Manish is also Chairman of the Board at Quintype Technologies, an AI-powered digital experience platform for news and media publishers. Quintype is a subsidiary of Quint Digital Limited (QDL), India's premier digital media technology company listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange. Additionally, he serves as Chairman of the Board at ListenFirst Media, a New York-based social media analytics and insights platform supporting Fortune 500 companies in media, entertainment, gaming and other industries.

As a mentor in the Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) AI stream at the University of Toronto, Manish actively guides startups, helping them scale and succeed in the competitive tech landscape.

Beyond business, Manish is deeply committed to philanthropy. He serves on the Board of the Eye-Bank for Sight Restoration in New York, a distinguished non-profit focused on curing blindness through transplantation. He is also leading the development of Altrus HealthCare for Women and Children in India, a hospital dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare for women and children, with a mission to support underprivileged communities.

Manish holds an MBA from Columbia University and a bachelor's degree from BITS Pilani, India. He has also completed the Executive Education Program on Leading Professional Service Firms at Harvard Business School. In recognition of his entrepreneurial achievements, he was named 'EY Entrepreneur of the Year (New Jersey)' in 2021.

Mekin deeply cares about people realizing their potential and succeeding in life.

Name: Nitin Monga
Bio:
Nitin Monga is a Founder of Plaksha University. Nitin Monga is a first-generation entrepreneur driven by a deep belief that technology is magic. It can be used to unlock dignity, equity, and opportunity especially for those who have historically been left out. With over two decades of experience across governance, grassroots transformation, and enterprise technology, he has focused on building systems that solve real, large-scale problems.

Growing up with a close view of rural India's aspirations and constraints, Nitin's professional journey has always been deeply personal. In 2007, he founded WE Excel with a bold idea: to solve real, persistent problems in India through e-governance. The early days were uncertain, but fueled by clarity of purpose and hands-on leadership, he built a respected e-governance solutions company from the ground up.

Nitin is best known for conceiving E-Kharid / Anaajkharid, a now-benchmark public food procurement platform that revolutionized how farmers in Haryana and Punjab sell their crops and receive payments. What sets him apart is not just the scale of the platforms he has built, but his instinct for public good, empathy for the last-mile user, and discipline in building trust with institutions and citizens alike.

His approach blends visionary thinking with quiet resilience, never chasing headlines, always focused on systemic value. Whether it is transforming the public education system through personalized digital learning or building India's next-generation ERP engine for the public sector, Nitin focuses on not just building technology but long-term capacity.

He also co-founded Appworx, iProfit, and Cropbiz.

Beyond products, he invests deeply in people and ecosystems. As a Co-founder at SACC India, he mentors early-stage startups from Tier 2 and rural belts, believing that empowering youth and women to solve local problems is India's greatest untapped advantage. Under his guidance, SACC has become one of the most trusted incubation platforms in North India, reaching 300,000+ youth and supporting 500+ startups.

In every room he is in, Nitin brings calm clarity, a systems perspective, and deep personal integrity. His work is about simplifying complexity, amplifying impact, and creating infrastructure that quietly empowers millions.

Looking ahead, Nitin is focused on collaborating with like-minded people and organizations to shape public digital infrastructure that is inclusive, intelligent, and rooted in India's realities, with a strong belief that technology can accelerate India's journey from a developing to a developed nation.
Education: BA, Panjab University
Research_Summary: Co-founder, WE Excel; Founder, Plaksha University

Name: Nitin Seth
Bio:
Nitin Seth is a Founder of Plaksha University. Nitin Seth is a global business leader, entrepreneur, and bestselling author. He is the Co-founder and CEO of Incedo Inc., a fast-growing data, digital, and AI services firm. With nearly three decades of leadership experience, Nitin has held pivotal roles at world-class organizations—including Director of McKinsey's Global Knowledge Centre, Managing Director and India Country Head of Fidelity International, and Chief Operating Officer of Flipkart, India's largest e-commerce company. Across these roles, he has led large-scale transformations in business, technology, data, and AI.

Nitin is the author of three acclaimed books. His debut, 'Winning in the Digital Age' (2021), became a national bestseller and won five prestigious business book awards, including the C.K. Prahalad Best Business Book Award. His second book, 'Mastering the Data Paradox' (2024), became a bestseller within a week of launch and has already won multiple awards. Nitin's third book, titled 'Human Edge in the AI Age', completing his trilogy on the transformation trifecta of Digital, Data and AI, was published in July 2025. The book, a timely and compelling reflection on the challenges and opportunities for humanity in the AI era—was recognized as an Amazon bestseller even before its release, achieving #1 bestseller position across multiple categories. Within a few days of its release, it also became a national bestseller for Penguin.

An alumnus of IIM Lucknow, where he received the Chairman's Gold Medal for academic excellence, and IIT Delhi, Nitin is widely regarded as a thought leader. He is a sought-after speaker on digital transformation, AI, leadership, innovation, and building high-performance teams, passionately inspiring individuals and organizations to thrive in a fast-changing world.
Education: MBA, IIM Lucknow
Research_Summary: Co-founder and CEO, Incedo Inc; Founder, Plaksha University

He began his venture capital journey in 2004, investing in Indian technology startups long before they gained global prominence.

He co-founded Erasmic Ventures in 2004, one of India's earliest seed funds, which later merged with Accel. Over the years, he has backed and nurtured some of India's most successful startups, including Agrostar, BlueStone, BookMyShow, Clevertap, FabHotels, Glowroad, HolidayMe, HomeLane, InfraMarket, PropTiger, QwikCilver (acquired by Pine Labs), Rentomojo, TeaBox and many others.

Beyond venture capital, Prashanth is deeply involved in fostering innovation and entrepreneurship in Karnataka and across India. As the co-founder of UnboxingBLR Foundation, he actively contributes to initiatives that support emerging businesses and technological advancements.

In recognition of his contributions to India's trade and industry, he was honored with the Padma Shri. His expertise in venture investing, strategic growth, and ecosystem development continues to drive impactful change in India's startup landscape.

Bio:
Prof Abhishek Dureja is an Assistant Professor of Economics at Plaksha University. His primary research areas include Health Economics, Development Economics, and Risk and Insurance. He combines secondary data with quasi-experimental methods to understand causal relationships and contribute to evidence-based policymaking.

Prior to joining Plaksha University, Prof Dureja was a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Centre for Management of Health Services at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad. For more details about his research and other activities, please visit his webpage.
Education: PhD, Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research, Mumbai
Research_Interests: Maternal and Child Health | Impact Assessment | Risk and Insurance | Food, Health, and Nutrition | Applied Econometrics | Health Economics | Development Economics

Name: Alok Ranjan
Bio:
Prof Alok Ranjan is an Assistant Professor of Economics at Plaksha University. He is an applied microeconomist with primary research interests in Public Economics and Urban Economics and secondary interests in Labor Economics and Political Economy. His work focuses on how institutions and policies shape economic behavior, with particular attention to transparency, governance, and inequality. In his research, Prof Ranjan combines large-scale administrative and survey data with state-of-the-art causal inference and machine learning techniques to answer policy-relevant questions.

Prior to joining Plaksha, Prof Ranjan earned his PhD in Economics from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. He holds BS and MS degrees from the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur. For more details, please visit his website.
Education: PhD, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | MS, IIT Kanpur | BS, IIT Kanpur
Research_Interests: Public Finance | Urban Economics | Labor Economics

Name: Amit Sheth
Bio:
Prof Amit Sheth is a Professor at Plaksha. He calls himself a 'tinkerer.' He has been a design practitioner and educator for the past three decades.

During his 30 years as a design consultant, Prof Sheth's firm, MIND'S EYE DESIGN Pvt Ltd, has provided design services in the areas of Product Design, Signage and Wayfinding Design, Exhibition Design, Corporate Branding, and Interiors and Architecture. He was instrumental in setting up the Design Institute at Nirma University, where he served as Professor and Head of the Department.

His current areas of interest are Universal Design and Wayfinding.
Education: MPhil, IIT Bombay | Masters in Product Design, National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad | BTech, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, BITS Pilani
Research_Interests: Design Thinking | Universal Design | Wayfinding and Signage Design | Inclusive Design

Name: Amith Shastri
Bio:
Dr Amith Shastri is a Assistant Professor at Plaksha. Dr Shastri is a mathematician specializing in Algebraic Geometry and Algebraic Groups. Prior to joining Plaksha, he was an Assistant Professor at Sai University. He completed his PhD at the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai, where he worked on homogeneous spaces and anti-affine groups. He then spent two years at the Chennai Mathematical Institute as a Postdoctoral Fellow.

In addition to his academic interests, Dr Shastri enjoys spending time in nature and is an avid wildlife photographer.
Education: PhD, Mathematics, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research | MSc, Mathematics, University of Madras | BSc, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, St. Aloysius College
Research_Interests: Algebraic geometry | Algebraic Groups | Graph Neural Networks

Name: Amruta R Behera
Bio:
Prof Amruta R Behera is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha. Prior to joining Plaksha, Prof Behera worked as a Postdoctoral Researcher at the Centre for Nano Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. There, he led a team to develop a pocket-sized near-infrared spectrometer for quality analysis of food and agricultural produce. The team pitched the product idea at Data Innovation Bazaar 2020, a national event organized by Western Digital, and was among the top 10 finalists.

Prof Behera received his BTech in Mechanical Engineering from the National Institute of Technology Warangal and completed his MSc (Engineering) and PhD in Nano Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. After his undergraduate studies, he worked as an engineer at Applied Materials India, where he contributed to the design and fabrication of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

He is also a Certified Instructor at Wolfram Research Inc and contributes as a consultant to the development of mathematics-based educational content.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru | MSc, Nano Science and Engineering, IISc Bengaluru | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Warangal
Research_Summary:
Prof Behera's PhD research focused on exploration of dynamic characteristics of microelectromechanical systems for potential sensing applications, and development of techniques for measurement of material properties in fabricated micro-mechanical structures.

At Plaksha, he plans to pursue utilitarian research focused on internet-of-things and sensor technologies, to find solutions for the grand challenges in the agriculture and healthcare sector.
Research_Interests: Sensor Technologies | Internet-of-Things | MEMS | IoT

Name: Anil K Roy
Bio:
Prof Anil K. Roy is a Professor at Plaksha. He is an alumnus of IIT Delhi and IIT Roorkee, and earned his PhD in Physics (Quantum Optics) from IIT Delhi in 1993. Prior to joining Plaksha, he was with Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT), Gandhinagar for 22 years where he taught courses such as Introduction to ICT, Engineering Design Workshop, Engineered Materials, Electromagnetic Theory, Solid State Devices, and Optical Fiber Communication. He has also worked at the Centre for Theoretical Studies, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, and later at the Fiber Optics Group of IIT Delhi.

Prof Roy is a senior member of IEEE and of Optica (formerly Optical Society of America), and a member of the Optical Society of India. He currently serves as the President of the IEEE Sensors Council (2026–2027), the largest technical council within IEEE. He has also served as Chair of the IEEE Conference Publications Committee (2019–2020).

His honors include the 2019 IEEE India Council Section Chair Lifetime Achievement Award, the 2017 IEEE Sensors Council Meritorious Service Award, the 2012 IEEE MGA Leadership Award, and the 2010 IEEE Region 10 Outstanding Volunteer Award.
Education: PhD, Physics, IIT Delhi | MSc, Physics, University of Roorkee | BSc, Physics, Science College, Patna University
Research_Summary:
Prof Roy's research and teaching span sensors, connected devices, image processing, fiber optics, semiconductor physics, and technologies with humanitarian applications.

Areas of work:

Sensors and sensor technology

Internet of Things

Image processing

Fiber optics and semiconductor physics

Technology applications for humanitarian challenges
Research_Interests: Sensors | Internet of Things (IoT) | Image Processing | Fiber Optics | Semiconductor Physics | Applications of technologies for humanitarian challenges | IoT | Sensors Technology | Machine Learning

Name: Ankur Nahar
Bio:
Prof Ankur Nahar is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University and Group Lead of Anvay Lab. He earned his PhD from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur, mentored by Prof Debasis Das of IIT Jodhpur and Prof Sajal K. Das of Missouri University of Science and Technology, USA.

His professional experience includes teaching as an Assistant Professor and working as a Network Engineer, contributing to student development, academic programs, and network management. He has engaged in international collaborations through academic visits to the University of Melbourne, Tashkent University of Information Technologies, and IIT Kharagpur. He has also presented his work at international symposiums.
Education: PhD, IIT Jodhpur
Research_Summary:
Prof Nahar's research focuses on scalable, secure, and intelligent network architectures for heterogeneous and real-time applications. His current thrust is to develop adaptive, programmable, and self-healing networks through intelligent control, resource allocation, congestion avoidance, and low-latency delivery.

Software-Defined Networking and Internet routing (BGP)

5G/6G core networks

Vehicular ad hoc networks, vehicular cloud computing, and intelligent transportation systems

Edge and fog computing

Network intelligence and adaptive resource management
Research_Interests: Vehicular ad-hoc networks | Congestion control in multipath TCP | Fifth-generation cellular networks | Routing optimization | Routing and Switching | Computer Networks | Cloud Computing

Name: Anupam Sobti
Bio:
Prof Anupam Sobti is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He is interested in applied research that Profives sustainable communities by reducing the information gap among various stakeholders, such as information about urban heat islands for city planners or crop health for insurance companies. He uses techniques from computer vision, machine learning, and embedded systems to design these systems. The group's recent focus has been on using self-supervised learning techniques to build scalable and generalizable models that can be applied to urban planning and agriculture.

Prof Sobti also leads the Geospatial Computer Vision Group at Plaksha. The group's vision is to develop state-of-the-art geospatial intelligence to support domains such as urban climate, agriculture, and water security. To learn more, explore the group's latest publications.

Prof Sobti welcomes collaborations with industry, startups, researchers, and students who share these goals. If you would like to collaborate, please get in touch.
Education: PhD, IIT Delhi | MTech, Microelectronics, BITS Pilani | BTech, ECE, NSUT, Delhi
Research_Interests: Geospatial and Embedded Perception | Deep Learning | Agriculture and Urban Planning | Embedded Systems | IoT | Applied Machine Learning

Name: Arshdeep Sidhu
Bio:
Prof Arshdeep Sidhu currently serves as an Assistant Professor and Assistant Dean, UG Outreach and Admissions at Plaksha University. She is a protein biochemist with a specialization in single molecule/conformation imaging using atomic force microscopy. Her research interest includes studying conformation-function of intrinsically disordered proteins and to develop protein-based materials for diverse applications.

She did her PhD from University of Twente, The Netherlands, where she studied polymorphism and functionalization of a Parkinson's disease associated protein – α-Synuclein. During her postdoctoral fellowship at Erasmus Medical Centre, Rotterdam, she studied the conformation-function relation of BRCA2 protein – a protein associated with breast cancer.

In addition to her research interests, Prof Sidhu likes to travel, learn new skills and is an environmentalist, who actively seeks and implements solutions for everyday sustainable living.
Education: PhD, University of Twente, The Netherlands
Research_Summary:
We study age associated diseases like Parkinson's disease, neuromuscular diseases and cancer from molecular, clinical and ecological perspective.

At molecular and clinical level, we aim to understand how some intrinsically disordered proteins self-assemble into functional (DNA repair foci/cancer) as well as pathogenic structures (protein aggregates/Parkinson's disease). We are passionate about developing physiologically relevant in-vitro model systems, based on liquid-liquid phase separation of proteins, to study DNA repair foci and liquid to solid transition of amyloidogenic proteins. Such model systems can be valuable tools to annotate clinical variants and guide clinical decision.

At ecological level, we want to understand how some persistent and emerging contaminants in water could modify risks for neuromuscular and neurodegenerative diseases.
Research_Interests: Intrinsically disordered proteins | Protein self-assembly in pathological aggregates and membraneless organelles | Biomarkers for Parkinson's disease | Protein based materials | Single molecule imaging | Protein Biochemistry

Name: Brainerd Prince
Designation: Director, Center for Thinking, Language and Communication
Bio:
Prof Brainerd Prince currently serves as the Director, Center for Thinking, Language and Communication and a Professor at Plaksha University. He has a keen interest in diverse fields, including Philosophy and Religion, Academic Research, Media and Communication, Business and Entrepreneurship, and Social Engagement. He has taught courses and presented papers at conferences and consultations at various universities and institutions in the UK, Europe, Southeast Asia, and India over the past 15 years. He has developed and directed a year-long PhD Preparatory Program through which several students from the Global South have successfully gained admission to UK universities for PhD programs.

As part of his commitment to social engagement through education, Prof Prince established the Touch India Trust Foundation and led a variety of projects and initiatives, including The Tent, a café with a difference for university students; InTouch India, an RNI-registered monthly youth magazine; and Shiksha Rath, an educational intervention program for underprivileged children living in the slums of North Delhi.
Education: PhD, Middlesex University, UK
Research_Interests: Phenomenological Hermeneutics | Philosophy and Practice of Education and Research | Academic Study of Hinduism | Philosophy of Religion | Religious Studies | Philosophy | Philosophy of Language

Name: Chaitanya Lekshmi Indira
Designation: Director, Center for Equitable and Personalized Healthcare
Bio: Prof Chaitanya Lekshmi Indira is the Director of the Center for Equitable and Personalized Healthcare and an Associate Professor at Plaksha University. She has more than 16 years of experience in materials science. She completed her master's degree and PhD at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, and was a Visiting Scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Before joining Plaksha, she headed the Centers for Materials Science and Sensors and Nanoelectronics at CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru. She teaches, supervises research, and mentors students.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru | MS, Chemistry, IISc Bengaluru
Research_Summary:
Prof Indira develops advanced functional nanostructured materials and composites for sensing, catalysis, healthcare, water quality monitoring, and sustainable energy. Her current research builds on electrochemical and optical sensing, catalysis, and structure–property relationships.

Areas of work:

Nanostructured materials and composites

Electrochemical and optical sensing, biosensors, and point-of-care diagnostics

Photoelectrocatalysis and catalysts for gas-phase reactions

Water security

Nano-spin electronics
Research_Interests: Nanostructured materials and composites | Structure-property correlations | Electrochemical and optical sensing | Biosensors | Point-of-care diagnostics | Photo-electro (catalysis) | Water Security | Catalysts for Gas phase reactions | Materials Science | Sensors and Catalysis
Publications_Sample: Prof Indira has authored 45 research publications in peer-reviewed international and national journals. Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.co.in/citations?user=AZVdneMAAAAJ&hl=en

Name: Deepak Khemani
Bio:
Prof Deepak Khemani is a Professor at Plaksha University. He has been working in Artificial Intelligence, with a focus on symbolic reasoning.

He began working in AI during his doctoral studies, where he explored the application of memory-based planning to the game of contract bridge. Contract bridge is a game yet to be conquered by AI, unlike games such as chess, Go, backgammon, and Scrabble, where machines rule supreme. His current research aims to combine knowledge representation, heuristic search, and constraint processing to build intelligent problem solvers. These methods can be applied to create articulate tutoring systems that help students solve mathematics and physics problems, among other applications.

Prof Khemani teaches core courses in Artificial Intelligence and offers popular courses on Search Methods, Knowledge Representation, and Constraint Satisfaction through the NPTEL/SWAYAM platform.
Education: PhD, IIT Bombay | MTech, Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Bombay | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Bombay
Research_Summary: Prof Khemani's research has been on approaches in which an autonomous agent can represent the world around it, draw upon experience to solve problems, and can imagine the future to search for solutions. He has conducted several projects for government and industry, as well as collaborative projects funded by BMBF Germany and UKIERI.
Research_Interests: Search methods for problem solving | Knowledge representation | Memory-based reasoning | Constraint satisfaction problems | Game playing | Epistemic logic | Artificial Intelligence
Publications_Sample: Prof Khemani's 2013 book A First Course in Artificial Intelligence (available here) has wide ranging coverage of the subject. His second more focused book Search Methods in Artificial Intelligence (available here) was published recently. | He has also had interest in popular science and was a member in the small team that started the children's science magazine Jantar Mantar in the early nineties, published by Tamil Nadu Science Forum. During that period he also wrote a small book Signs of the Zodiac, explaining astronomy to young children. A scanned copy can be found here.

Name: Deepan Muthirayan
Bio:
Prof Deepan Muthirayan is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University.

He earned his PhD from the University of California, Berkeley, in 2016 and his Dual Degree (BTech/MTech) from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras in 2010. His doctoral thesis focused on market mechanisms for integrating demand flexibility into energy markets. He was a Postdoctoral Associate in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Cornell University, where his work focused on optimization, parametric learning, and matching markets. He then served as a Postdoctoral Fellow at the University of California, Irvine, where his research focused on topics at the intersection of machine learning, decision and control, online learning, and optimization.

His current research spans reinforcement learning, machine learning, robotics, and multi-agent systems.
Education: PhD, University of California, Berkeley | Dual Degree BTech, MTech, IIT Madras
Research_Summary: Prof Muthirayan's current research interests lie in reinforcement learning, robotics, and online learning.
Research_Interests: Control Theory | Reinforcement Learning and Robotics | Online Learning | Game Theory and Mechanism Design | Artificial Intelligence | Computer Science

Name: Dhiraj Sinha
Bio: Prof Dhiraj Sinha is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He studied electrical engineering at the Institute of Engineering and Technology, University of Lucknow, India and Telecommunications at ENST de Bretagne, Brest, France. He later earned a PhD in Electrical Engineering from University of Cambridge, UK. During the latter part of his stay at Cambridge and as the CTO of Smantenna Ltd, a thin film based antenna startup, he worked on research and commercialization of thin film based antennas. This was followed by a brief stint at Oscion, a technology consulting firm, following which he joined the Singapore University of Technology and Design, Singapore as a Research Fellow.
Education: PhD, University of Cambridge
Research_Summary: Prof Sinha's research interests are converged towards radiating structures with low degrees of freedom. He has explored ultra-small antenna design and sensing, besides investigating thermodynamics and electromagnetic field effects in microscopic systems with low dimensions.
Research_Interests: Microelectromechanical systems (micromachines, sensors and actuators) | Ultra-small antenna design for cellular technologies | Thermodynamics and electromagnetic field effects in microscopic systems with low dimensions | MEMS | Sensors Technology

Name: Divyanshu Jain
Bio: Prof Divyanshu Jain is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha. Before his doctoral training, he completed an MBA at IIM Ahmedabad and worked in the Investment Banking division at PwC. He teaches applied microeconomics with sports data, and investments and valuations. More details are available on his personal website.
Education: PhD, IIM Ahmedabad | MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | B.Com (Hons.), Kirori Mal College, University of Delhi
Research_Summary:
Prof Jain studies organizational, education, labor, and sports economics. His work uses quasi-experimental methods and rich administrative data to examine incentives, performance, and policy-relevant questions.

Areas of work:

Organizational economics

Education and labor economics

Sports economics

Gender gaps in science education

Monitoring precision and performance
Research_Interests: Organizational economics | Education | Labor | Sports | Sports Economics

Name: Jenny Tilsen
Bio: Prof Jenny Tilsen is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. Her teaching treats science and technology as lived experiences, infrastructures, and practices that shape how we interact with ourselves, each other, and the world. Her courses invite students to connect theory with everyday experience. She teaches Reimagining Tech and Society, Engineering Ethics, and related electives. Before joining Plaksha, she was a postdoctoral ethnographer studying cultural change in an engineering department at Bucknell University. More information is available at https://www.jennytilsen.com/home/.
Education: PhD, University of Minnesota | EdM, Harvard Graduate School of Education | BA, Saint Catherine University
Research_Summary:
Prof Tilsen studies how science and technology are socially produced within expert and public communities. Her current work examines how communication, infrastructure, values, and ethics shape knowledge-making, and how knowledge cultures and technologies are negotiated across social and environmental contexts.

Areas of work:

Public engagement with science

Social epistemology and Science and Technology Studies

Transdisciplinary research and creative collaboration

Storytelling, science fiction, values, and ethics
Research_Interests: Public engagement with science | Social Epistemology | Science fiction | Transdisciplinary research and creative collaborations | Storytelling | Values and Ethics | Transdisciplinary Research | Science and Technology Studies

Name: Malini Balakrishnan
Bio:
Prof Malini Balakrishnan currently serves as the Director, Center for Water Security and a Professor at Plaksha University. Prior to joining Plaksha, she was a Senior Fellow at The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), New Delhi, where she spent over 25 years working closely with different industry sectors to improve resource use, resource recovery, and waste utilization. Her work on enhancing resource efficiency in small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across multiple sectors, including metal fabrication and finishing, and the manufacture of chemicals and intermediates, in India and select South Asian countries has resulted in significant savings in energy, water, and raw materials.

Prof Balakrishnan's experience spans the execution and coordination of pilot demonstrations of technologies such as membrane filtration (for upgrading the juice clarification process in the Indian sugar industry), diffusion dialysis, acid retardation, nanofiltration-based recovery systems (for waste acid and rinse water in Indian metal-finishing SMEs), and membrane bioreactors for sewage treatment.
Education: PhD, IIT Delhi | MASc, Chemical Engineering, University of Waterloo, Canada | MSc Hons, Chemistry, BITS Pilani | BE Hons, Chemical Engineering, BITS Pilani
Research_Summary:
Prof Balakrishnan's research efforts have been primarily targeted at evolving affordable solutions to specific local problems. She initiated and led TERI's efforts in field testing of membrane bioreactors (MBRs) for wastewater treatment using indigenously prepared membranes from industrial waste. Her experience in various pilot demonstrations have provided a deeper understanding of challenges in technology adaptation and possible approaches that would encourage the uptake of such technologies.

Furthermore, she has worked extensively in partnership with various international and national research groups, leading several multi-institutional international projects. Many of these projects were funded by the European Commission, with TERI as the lead partner. Overall, Prof Balakrishnan has successfully integrated applied R&D with academic research.
Research_Interests: Wastewater treatment | Membrane technologies | Resource recovery | Translating technology solutions | Circular economy | Wastewater | Resource Efficiency
Publications_Sample: As an adjunct faculty at the TERI School of Advanced Studies, Prof Balakrishnan has supervised PhD candidates and published over 100 research papers (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=LGcvSiEAAAAJ&hl=en). She has served as a nominated expert in select programmes of the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, in the Chemical Division Council of Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), and as a reviewer for various funding agencies and peer-reviewed international journals.

Name: Mayank Ratan Bhardwaj
Bio:
Prof Mayank Ratan Bhardwaj is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He earned his PhD from the Department of Computer Science and Automation at the Indian Institute of Science and his MTech from IIT Kanpur. His doctoral dissertation focused on improving agricultural planning and operations using Artificial Intelligence and Game Theory.

He has experience working across different industry verticals, contributing to the development of firmware, video conferencing tools, EDA tools, search engines, and business development initiatives.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru | MTech, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Kanpur
Research_Interests: Applied Game Theory | Mechanism Design | Graph Theory | Data Analytics | Computational Social Choice | Game Theory | AI for Social Good
Publications_Sample: https://sites.google.com/view/mayank-ratan-bhardwaj/publications | Google Scholar (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=yqUlWAgAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao) | DBLP (https://dblp.org/pid/319/4371.html)

Name: Monika Sharma
Bio: Prof Monika Sharma currently serves as the Program Chair, Biological Systems Engineering and an Associate Professor at Plaksha University. Her research interests include the application of computational methods to understand biological processes, especially those provided by conformational dynamics. Her work lies at the interface of Chemistry (understanding interactions), Physics (defining rules), Mathematics (integrators and statistical analyses), and Computer Science (extracting, analysing, and interpreting data). She is particularly interested in integrating deep learning with the study of conformational dynamics to identify characteristics that may indicate underlying disrupted biological mechanisms and be amenable to treatment, ultimately improving survival and facilitating clinical decision-making. Her vision is to create a world-class research environment where she can translate fundamental research into biomedical applications that benefit society and the healthcare industry.
Education: PhD, IIIT Hyderabad
Research_Interests: Computational Biophysics | Biomolecular modeling and dynamics | Computer-assisted drug designing | Bioinformatics

Name: Navjot Kaur
Bio:
Prof Navjot Kaur currently serves as an Assistant Dean, UG Outreach and Admissions and an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. Academically trained as a chemical engineer, she fell in love with biology during her graduate studies. She earned her PhD from the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, where she worked on developing point-of-care molecular diagnostics. Before joining Plaksha University as a founding faculty member, she was a Research Scientist at Reddy's Laboratories, one of India's leading generic pharmaceutical companies.

As a founding faculty member, she is actively involved in outreach and admissions, culture building, and the Young Technology Scholars (YTS) programme at Plaksha University. She is a systems thinker, passionate about sustainable food production and consumption. Her group develops holistic solutions that integrate technology development, responsible innovation, and stakeholder engagement to address the grand challenge of food security. She teaches courses on Nature's Machines, Molecular Biology, and Nucleic Acid and Protein Biosensors.

For more information, please visit her research webpage.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru
Research_Summary:
Prof Kaur's group conducted an extensive field-study surveying 600 farmers across 200 villages in 8 different districts of Punjab to understand the agricultural ecosystem and connect with the farming communities. Continued interactions of her group with farming communities in Punjab highlighted the prevalence of fungal diseases in the state farms and the excessive use of agrochemicals to manage crop diseases.

Extensive agricultural activities have also polluted and depleted the natural environment in the state; including soil, water and air. Her research is focused on developing sustainable therapeutics to improve the agriculture ecosystems in Punjab and overtime extend their findings and technologies to the rest of the country.
Research_Interests: Fungal Biocontrol Agents | Soil Fungal Microbiome

Name: Pankaj Pansari
Bio:
Prof Pankaj Pansari is an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Division at Plaksha University. His research interests include improving the reasoning abilities of LLMs and accelerating the inference and training of LLMs. He heads the Kestrel Lab at Plaksha.

Prof Pansari earned his PhD from the University of Oxford and his BTech from IIT Kharagpur. He has worked at Naver Labs Europe (Grenoble, France) and General Electric (Bengaluru, India).

His ML Systems course website: https://ai4103-mlsys.github.io/
Education: PhD, University of Oxford | MTech, IIT Kharagpur | BTech, IIT Kharagpur
Research_Summary: Prof Pansari's research themes are machine learning systems and LLM reasoning. He is interested in methods for speeding up inference of AI models so that they are able to make good utilization of expensive hardware resources. He also focus on developing benchmarks to measure and characterize ability of AI models on tasks that go beyond math and programming and are more representative of the scenarios in which we want to use these models in the real-world.
Research_Interests: Machine learning systems | LLM reasoning | Machine Learning | Optimization

Name: Prakarsh Singh
Designation: Program Chair, Data Science, Economics and Business
Bio:
Prof Prakarsh Singh is Director of the Lab for Economic Behaviour in Organisations (LEO) at Plaksha University and chairs the Data Science, Economics and Business major.

With over 15 years of research in academia and industry with invited presentations at 100+ leading global academic and policy institutions, he has a track record of collaborating with the world's leading economists and scientists, obtaining research grants, and making policy impact. His papers have been published in prestigious peer-reviewed journals, including, Journal of Health Economics, Journal of Development Economics, Economics of Education Review, European Economic Review and Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization, Journal of Conflict Resolution. His research projects have been funded by the Gates Foundation (Grand Challenges), The World Bank, United Nations and State governments in India. Work has led to policy impact and 500+ citations. His areas of research and teaching include personnel economics, health economics, behavioral economics, microeconomics, and economics of conflict.

Prof Singh has taught at the world's top-ranked liberal arts colleges (Amherst and Swarthmore College), with visiting positions at University of Pennsylvania, University of Navarra (Spain) and Liberal Arts Initiative (China). His courses have been featured in the world's leading economic education journal, Journal of Economic Education.

He was a former Science leader at Amazon where he led an innovative team of economists, scientists and business intelligence engineers that curates Strategic Insights for Amazon's leaders.

Name: Prashanth Suresh Kumar
Bio:
Prof Prashanth Suresh Kumar is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He conducted his research as a water technologist in a highly multidisciplinary environment. Following his doctoral and postdoctoral research, he was involved in education programmes aimed at inspiring high school students to pursue careers in science and technology. He is passionate about teaching and communicating science to a wide variety of audiences, including academicians, industrialists, policymakers, students, and the general public. He also has a passion for endurance sports and enjoys running marathons and cycling long distances.

At Plaksha, Prof Kumar aims to collaborate and address the grand challenges in the water sector in India. He is keen to continue pursuing research that can be translated into real-world applications. He is also excited to interact with students and co-create a vibrant learning culture, both within and beyond the classroom.
Education: PhD, Delft University of Technology
Research_Summary:
Prof Kumar conducted his PhD research on addressing the globally pressing issue of harmful algal blooms (HABs) formed in water bodies. To stop the formation of HABs, his research focused on reducing the phosphate discharge from wastewater effluents to ultra-low concentrations. This was done by designing adsorbents that could selectively bind and release phosphate. The research was performed in close collaboration with industries and academic institutes, and resulted in piloting the technology for surface water and wastewater remediation in Canada and Sweden, respectively.

At Plaksha, Prof Kumar currently works for the Centre for Water Security, tackling the various water problems in the Indian context. This includes working on energy efficient technologies for zero liquid discharge of industrial effluents. He is also interested in exploring new ways for water quality monitoring, optimizing resource recovery from wastewater and understanding net zero water systems.
Research_Interests: Wastewater treatment | Resource recovery from wastewater | Zero Liquid discharge in industrial effluents | Circular economy and net zero water | Adsorbents and regeneration | Water Technology

Name: Rajesh Sharma
Designation: Associate Dean, Harish and Bina Shah School of AI and Computer Science
Bio:
Prof Rajesh Sharma currently serves as an Associate Dean, Harish and Bina Shah School of AI and Computer Science, Program Chair, Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, and as a Professor at Plaksha University. Prior to joining Plaksha, he was an Associate Professor (January 2022–January 2025) and led the Computational Social Science Group at the Institute of Computer Science, University of Tartu, Estonia. Rajesh also holds adjunct faculty positions at IIT Ropar, IIIT Delhi, the University of Tartu, Estonia, Lakehead University, Canada, and the Kyiv School of Economics, Ukraine.

His research group works on understanding societal challenges such as misinformation, hate speech, segregation, mental health, and user behaviour by analysing digital traces, including financial transactions, mobile call data records, and social media data. The group applies techniques from Artificial Intelligence (AI), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Network Science, particularly Social Network Analysis.

Earlier, Prof Sharma joined the University of Tartu in August 2017 as a Senior Researcher, where he worked until December 2020. From January 2014 to July 2017, he held Research Fellow and Postdoctoral Researcher positions at the University of Bristol, Queen's University Belfast, UK, and the University of Bologna, Italy. Prior to that, he earned his PhD from Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in December 2013. After completing his Master's from the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, he worked in the IT industry for about two and a half years.
Education: PhD, Nanyang Technological University | MTech, IIT Roorkee | BTech, Punjab Technical University

Name: Rucha Joshi
Bio: Prof Rucha Joshi is an Associate Professor at Plaksha University, specifically in natural biomaterials (silk fibroin, collagen) with transformative engineering education reforms. With a PhD and postdoctoral training in Biomedical Engineering (Purdue University), she holds patents for collagen-based drug delivery and banana-peel biscuits, several publications in engineering education as well as bioengineering, exemplifying her innovative spirit. Her research spans tissue engineering and inclusive pedagogy, where she pioneers metacognition, gamification, and human-centered design, and inclusive education, including women in higher education aspiring to be leaders, and visually impaired students in STEM. She has directed Plaksha's Grand Challenges Scholars Program, served on ASEE's diversity committees, and led NSF-backed initiatives to bridge gaps in engineering education. Recognized with the Chhabria Award (2023) for her professional impact, she's also a Springer-published book author and Maharashtra State literary awardee for her memoir in Marathi. Beyond academia, Prof Joshi is a NAUI-certified diver, Punjab State badminton champion, and advocate for women in STEM, embodying the synergy of science, education, and societal change.

Name: Rudra Pratap
Bio:
Prof Rudra Pratap is the Founding Vice Chancellor of Plaksha University. Prior to joining Plaksha University, he served as the Deputy Director of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru; Founding Chairperson of the Centre for Nano Science and Engineering (CeNSE); Professor at CeNSE; and Professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at IISc.

A pioneer in the field of Micro- and Nano-Electro-Mechanical Systems, Prof Pratap was associated with the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, for almost 25 years (1996–2021) and is credited with establishing the globally recognised Centre for Nano Science and Engineering at IISc. He was also a Visiting Professor at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland, in 2004–2005. Prior to joining IISc in 1996, he taught at the Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Cornell University, for two and a half years.

Prof Pratap holds a BTech Hons degree from IIT Kharagpur, an MS from the University of Arizona, and a PhD from Cornell University.

He is an elected Fellow of the National Academy of Engineering and National Academy of Science.

Name: Samuel Wright
Bio:
Samuel Wright's research areas are the history and philosophy of South Asia from the sixteenth to nineteenth centuries and, increasingly, the philosophy of technology and climate philosophy.

His current projects include a special journal issue, 'The Daily Life of Time in South Asia, 1300-1800', which seeks to explore how time and temporality are employed to effect certain relations between people and sustain institutions. And he has forthcoming publications on topics such as the history of philosophy in eighteenth-century South Asia and how the unit of the hour became the standard unit of time in South Asia.

He is also working on two books. The first, Technological Time and the Making of Simultaneity, explores how contemporary technological society exerts a temporal pressure on thought. And the second, The Metaphysics of Climes: earth and planet in climatic reflection, explores the disclosure of earth through climes and the danger of such disclosure failing.

His first book is A Time of Novelty: logic, emotion, and intellectual life in early modern India, 1500-1700 CE (Oxford University Press, 2021). And he has published in venues such as Journal of Asian Studies, Journal of Indian Philosophy, Indian Economic and Social History Review, and Modern Asian Studies.

At Plaksha, he regularly teaches 'Facing Earth: introduction to planetary humanities' and 'Early Modern Indian Philosophy'. And he directs the research project 'Absence: a metaphysics for the world'.

Many of his publications are available on his Academia.edu page.
Education: PhD, University of Chicago
Research_Interests: Intellectual History | History of Emotions | Time and Temporality | Indian Philosophy | Climate Studies | Philosophy | History

Name: Sanjeev Khosla
Bio:
Prof Sanjeev Khosla is a Professor at Plaksha University. His research focuses on the epigenetic dialogue between species, cells, and molecules. His laboratory has been investigating the epigenetic circuitry underlying the regulation of gene expression by environmental cues during both development and disease, to uncover the role of epigenetic mechanisms in the evolution of microbe-host interactions.

Prof Khosla completed his doctoral research at the Indian Institute of Science, followed by postdoctoral research at the Babraham Institute and the Wellcome Trust/Cancer Research UK Institute, Cambridge, UK. He served as a Staff Scientist at the Centre for DNA Fingerprinting and Diagnostics for more than 18 years and as the Director of the Institute of Microbial Technology for six years.
